Pay Plan Title:Supervisor II

Working Title:Population Health Nurse Supervisor

Position Number:91466

FLSA Status:Exempt

Posting Salary Range:$74,277 - $99,343

Office Location:Remote within North Carolina.

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Population Health Nurse Supervisor to join our team! The Population Health Nurse Supervisor is responsible for the administrative oversight and clinical supervision of the Population Health Nurses who provide care management and care coordination services, linkage/referrals, and discharge planning activities. Reporting to the Population Health Nurse Manager, the Population Health Nurse Supervisor is available to licensed and non-licensed staff to perform clinical triage, lead on emergency or crisis calls/contacts, or provide guidance and support, as needed.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Monitor and oversee the activities of the Nurse Team to ensure the needs of members, families, and stakeholders are addressed appropriately, expeditiously, and in a courteous manner.
  • Identify member needs and escalate appropriately to the Nurse Manager, Director, or other appropriate Trillium staff.
  • Monitor and review data to ensure performance measures and benchmarks are consistently met.
  • Provide education to staff to ensure performance improvement and to maintain adherence and compliance with accreditation standards.
  • Provide direct supervision and clinical guidance to nursing staff.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Three (3) years of experience providing care management, case management, or care coordination to BH/MH/SU/IDD population and a minimum of three (3) years as an RN.
  • Licensed in North Carolina by the State Board of Nursing as a Registered Nurse (RN).
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Experience working with acute care discharge planning and/or utilization management, including behavioral health, mental health, and physical health care needs.
  • Experience coordinating physical healthcare needs.
  • A minimum of one (1) year of experience providing direct supervision of staff (2 or more employees) that provide BH/MH/SU and/or IDD services.

Deadline for Application:Monday, August 10, 2026 @ 11:59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

raw.title: Vice President, Trade Relations & Formulary Strategy
raw.excerpt: Who We Are:SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

  • Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
  • Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
  • Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

The Vice President of Trade Relations & Formulary Strategy is a critical executive leadership role responsible for the manufacturer-facing side of our supply chain. You will define and execute SmithRx’s enterprise rebate strategy, formulary management, and clinical criteria, ensuring alignment with our 100% pass-through and transparent business model.

Unlike traditional PBM roles focused on maximizing retained rebate revenue, this role focuses on driving the lowest net cost and highest clinical value for our clients. You will lead negotiations with pharmaceutical manufacturers, oversee our Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) partnerships, and direct the strategic design of our formularies and clinical utilization management programs.

What you will do:

  • Trade Relations & Manufacturer Strategy

    • Lead Manufacturer Negotiations: Establish and maintain strategic relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, leading negotiations for rebates, discounts, and value-based contracts that align with SmithRx’s financial objectives and commitment to client transparency.
    • GPO Management: Oversee our rebate Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) partnerships and administration, ensuring compliance, financial accuracy, and strategic alignment with our pass-through model.
    • Market Access & Pipeline Monitoring: Monitor pharmaceutical market dynamics, generic pipelines, and biosimilar launches to proactively position SmithRx’s trade and contracting strategies ahead of market shifts.
    • Rebate Analytics: Provide executive oversight for rebate financial modeling, market assessments, and guarantee development in partnership with the Pricing and Underwriting teams.

    Formulary Strategy & Management

    • Formulary Design: Serve as the executive owner of SmithRx’s formulary strategy, ensuring recommendations are grounded in clinical evidence, market intelligence, and lowest-net-cost financial modeling.
    • P&T Committee Leadership: Lead and oversee the Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) / Formulary Advisory Committee, setting standards for governance, documentation, and objective decision-making rationale.
    • Client & Consultant Engagement: Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to clearly articulate the clinical and financial value of our formulary strategies to prospective clients and benefits consultants.
    • Experience with formulary management and utilization management across government programs (i.e. Medicare and Medicaid)

    Clinical Criteria Strategy & Management

    • Utilization Management (UM): Direct the development and deployment of clinical criteria for Prior Authorizations (PA), Step Therapy (ST), and Quantity Limits (QL) to ensure appropriate utilization, prevent waste, and optimize patient outcomes.
    • Clinical Philosophy Alignment: Ensure all clinical criteria and UM programs maintain strict independence from manufacturer influence, prioritizing patient health and employer savings over rebate qualification.
    • Specialty Drug Strategy: Collaborate with clinical leadership to design innovative management strategies for high-cost specialty drugs, gene therapies, and orphan drugs.

    Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Internal Alignment: Partner with executive peers across Pharmacy Networks, Clinical Operations, Sales, Finance, and Analytics to ensure integrated supply chain execution.
    • Team Development: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of trade relations directors, clinical pharmacists, and data analysts.

What you will bring to SmithRx:

  • Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in PBM trade relations, pharmaceutical market access, formulary management, or related clinical strategy roles.
  • Experience across various lines of business: Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange
  • Industry Expertise: Deep understanding of the PBM ecosystem, drug manufacturer contracting, GPO structures, and the operational differences between traditional rebate aggregators and 100% pass-through PBMs.
  • Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of successfully negotiating complex rebate and value-based contracts with major pharmaceutical manufacturers.
  • Clinical Foundation: Strong grasp of clinical pharmacology, drug pipelines, and evidence-based medicine required to guide P&T committees and clinical criteria development.
  • Analytical Acumen: Strong financial modeling skills with the ability to translate complex rebate structures into lowest-net-cost strategies.
  • Education: PharmD degree is highly preferred; Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or Healthcare Administration combined with extensive industry experience will be considered. Active pharmacist license in good standing is a plus.

What SmithRx Offers You:

  • Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Program
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Discretionary Paid Time Off
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Wellness Benefits
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Paid Parental Leave benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Well-stocked kitchen in office locations
  • Professional development and training opportunities

  • San Francisco Bay Area - California
  • Metro New York City - Connecticut, New Jersey, New York and Pennsylvania

  • California - outside of San Francisco Bay Area

  • Non metro Colorado, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and West Virginia

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: The range listed above reflects our standard pay scale and actual pay will vary based on work location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
  • Total Rewards: In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. SmithRx offers a variety of benefits to help you live well, including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance and 401(k).

Individual offers are tailored to your geography, experience, skills, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details during the hiring process. In the meantime, feel free to explore our comprehensive benefits here.

Bring a Trailer is where passion for cars meets storytelling and community. As a Production Specialist, you’ll play a key role in shaping how standout vehicles are presented to an engaged global audience—guiding sellers from submission to a successful auction experience.

Hearst Magazines’ portfolio of more than 30 powerful brands in the U.S. reaches more than 165 million people every month across print, digital, video, and social platforms. The company’s diverse portfolio includes many of the world’s most iconic and trusted media brands, including Cosmopolitan, ELLE, Esquire, Good Housekeeping, Harper’s BAZAAR, Popular Mechanics, and Runner’s World, as well as enthusiast titles like Car and Driver and Road & Track.

Key Responsibilities (What You Are Doing)

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first mindset and a professional, approachable communication style

  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and build trust with stakeholders

  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges independently while knowing when to escalate

  • Interest in or knowledge of collector cars and automotive culture; hands-on automotive experience is a plus

This is a full-time position that can be done remotely. Please note that we can only consider applicants from the following states: CA, CO, DE, FL, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, WI.

  • Plan for Your Financial Future: Enjoy competitive financial perks, including a 401(k) plan with a generous company match.

raw.title: Clinical Study Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care.
raw.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

As a Clinical Study Operations Manager within the Clinical Study Operations team, you will be responsible for ensuring the successful operational delivery of Beacon’s clinical studies, from startup through close-out. You will work closely with sponsors, project teams, and clinical sites to drive efficient study execution and uphold Beacon’s commitment to quality, compliance, and scientific rigor.
You will oversee study startup planning, site onboarding and training, and ongoing operational oversight to ensure studies are executed on time and to the highest standards. Acting as a key operational partner to both sponsors and internal teams, you will proactively identify risks, streamline communication, and maintain alignment across stakeholders. In addition, you will foster a culture of quality within the organization by coaching peers on GCP compliance, documentation discipline, version control, and complaint management, strengthening the team’s collective operational excellence.
This individual contributor role is fully remote, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Central Time zone. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York and Paris.

What success looks like:

  • Collaborate with project teams to implement study startup activities, including communication planning, logistics, development of study documentation, and data configuration.
  • Instill confidence with clients on study operations through start up, maintenance and close out activities.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clinical sites, ensuring smooth operations and clear communication.
  • Provide training to research sites on the use of Beacon’s devices and study protocols, ensuring proper device usage and data collection.
  • Monitor project progress, ensuring adherence to timelines, protocols, and quality standards.
  • Maintain compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, and regulatory standards.
  • Foster a culture of quality within the ClinOps and Scientific teams by coaching peers on GCP requirements, documentation discipline, versioning, and complaint management.
  • Address operational issues promptly, escalating through tools like Zendesk and Asana for resolution.
  • Provide actionable feedback from research sites to inform improvements in devices and workflows.

What you will bring:

  • Experience in clinical project management or clinical operations roles.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a bonus.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to identify priorities and anticipate challenges.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data collection and reporting.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment with multiple priorities.
  • Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and clinical research regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of decentralized data collection, compliance and oversight while showing empathy for both patients and sites.
  • A desire to learn more about analytics, statistics, machine learning, and clinical trials.
The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.
At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

raw.description:
About DialpadDialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer
At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic.

About the Dialership Program
At Dialpad, Continuous Innovation and Doing the Right Thing aren't just values — they're how we build. We believe the future is agentic, and we're committed to creating real access and opportunity for the next generation of leaders who will shape it. The Dialership Program is our way of opening that door.

Dialership is a rare opportunity to go behind the scenes of an Agentic AI-powered technology company — one that is actively leading the shift from AI that simply answers to AI that reasons, decides, and acts. Participants spend 2 hours per week exploring the different business functions that power Dialpad, gaining insights and coaching directly from leaders at the forefront of the agentic era.

The program runs virtually from June through August 2027. Because our focus is education, no work projects will be assigned, and the program is unpaid.

Upon successful completion, Dialership participants will receive a certificate of completion to share on their resume and LinkedIn.

Your role

As a Dialership participant, you'll attend two sessions per week and hear directly from Dialers about their roles, what they and their teams are working on, their career journeys, and the skills they believe matter most for success in the industry. Every session is designed to be both informative and interactive, giving you a real look at what each function does and how it all comes together inside an Agentic AI company.

You'll explore a wide range of business areas, including:

  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Engineering
  • People Experience and Recruiting
  • Customer Success
  • AI Strategy
  • Creative Design
  • Product Management
  • Finance
  • IT and Security
  • Growth Marketing and more!

Along the way, you'll have the chance to network with key leaders, get feedback on your resume and LinkedIn profile, and experience firsthand what makes Dialpad's culture so special.

About you

You're curious about technology, business communications, or AI, and you're excited about the idea of learning from people who are building the future of it. You can come from any background — high school, college, career transition, US-based, or international — and you're ready to commit 2 hours per week to show up, engage, and connect with the industry leaders who will be in the room with you.

Why Join Dialpad

  • Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
  • Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
  • Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

raw.description:
CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing CMMC Compliance and Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Customer Success Manager to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don’t improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization’s security posture. Our professionals advise clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Confident, ‘doers’ who ‘get the job done’ and strive to ‘do the right thing, even when no-one is looking’ are the types of candidates who strive in our culture. Additionally, our most successful team members are self-starters and willing to put on many hats to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

About the Role

CyberSheath, a fast-growing, 2x private equity-backed cybersecurity company, is seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) who can own outcomes—not tasks—and serve as the single point of accountability for their customers’ success. This is a high-ownership, customer-facing role for someone who can think like a general manager of their accounts and drive results through internal execution, not by passing problems down the line.

CSMs at CyberSheath are the single point of accountability—customers don’t need to understand our org chart because their CSM handles everything. This includes onboarding, managing the execution of compliance and technical projects, coordinating internal teams, escalating risks with solutions, and creating long-term customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, an understanding of the intersection between compliance, cybersecurity, and IT, and a relentless focus on execution, retention, and upsell opportunity identiﬁcation. You will not succeed in this role by reacting to emails and attending meetings all day. This role requires structured thinking, disciplined work habits, and true customer ownership

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Ownership – Act as the single point of accountability for a portfolio of managed service customers. Own the relationship, retention, and the customer’s experience
  • Execution Coordination – Manage the execution of onboarding, corrective action plans, technology rollouts, environment builds, and other technical projects— ensuring technicians and internal teams stay on task, on time, and a CSM is not a technical subject matter expert, more like a conductor of the orchestra than an instrument player.
  • Project & Process Management – Use existing playbooks to manage project workﬂows, but also reﬁne and scale them as you identify improvements
  • Escalation with Accountability – Identify issues early, propose mitigation paths, and escalate with clarity—not chaos. You are accountable for resolution, not just
  • Strategic Relationship Building – Create meaningful relationships across customer orgs (technical, operational, and executive) to ensure depth and stability in the account.
  • BusinessReviews&CustomerCommunication– Conduct structured quarterly business reviews, track KPIs, and clearly communicate outcomes, progress, and risks.
  • Instrumentation & Organization – Use internal dashboards and available data (ticket queues, backlog, VIP activity, escalations) to guide your priorities. If it’s off track, you’re already on it.
  • Retention & Upsell Support – Monitor health indicators and expand account value by identifying upsell opportunities and ensuring contract renewals.
  • Internal Team Leadership – Hold internal teams accountable to deadlines and standards. Everyone at CyberSheath is empowered to do what’s required to deliver great service—you included.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers are never confused about who to contact—they rely on you, and you know who to loop in.
  • Projects are completed on time, with zero surprises.
  • Internal teams are responsive and accountable because you hold them to it.
  • You surface issues before they become churn risks.
  • Your accounts renew, expand, and consistently deliver positive feedback.
  • You run your day with data, not noise.
  • You are a trusted, strategic advisor to your customer—not just a project

Who You Are

  • Execution-Driven – You don’t pass problems along; you ﬁx them.
  • Organized & Disciplined – You structure your day, know your metrics, and guide internal teams with clarity.
  • Customer-Focused – You know how to speak to business leaders and ensure our services drive real customer value.
  • Accountable – You take full ownership of customer outcomes and internal execution, even when it’s messy.
  • Proactive Communicator – You don’t wait for things to break—you see risk coming and address it early.
  • Process-Oriented but Flexible – You follow the playbook, but you’re always looking for ways to improve and scale it.

Why This Role?

  • Own your customer relationships, top to bottom—with the authority to make things happen.
  • Work at the heart of compliance, cybersecurity, and managed IT for mission-critical clients in the defense industrial base.
  • Join a team that values ownership, urgency, and accountability.
  • Get access to a complete set of tools and data—you just need to take initiative and act.
  • Work remotely in a high-performance culture with a team that shares your standards.
  • Be measured on the things that matter: execution, retention, and customer impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience as a CSM in a tech-focused environment (MSP-preferred)
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of IT systems and platforms
  • Experience providing end-user technical support
  • Certifications: A+, Security+, Network+, AZ-900, CISM, CCNA

Work Environment

  • A virtual work environment

CyberSheath is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

Budgeted Pay Range
$100,000—$115,000 USD

Position Title: Financial Controller

Compensation: $120,000-$145,000 base salary + performance-based bonus

Location: Remote


About the Firm
52TEN is a private investment firm based in Scottsdale, Arizona specializing in the acquisition and reposition of manufactured housing communities across the United States. As one of the top 100 community owners in the country, we are focused on delivering exceptional experiences for our residents, investors, partners, and team members.

Our current portfolio includes approximately 1,800 manufactured housing lots and $140M in assets under management, and we are continuing to grow through disciplined acquisitions and operational excellence.

About the Role

As we continue to grow our national portfolio, we're looking for an experienced Financial Controller to lead our accounting function and build the financial foundation that supports our next stage of growth.

This is more than a traditional Controller role. You'll oversee financial reporting, month-end close, investor distributions, and the accounting team while partnering closely with executive leadership to improve systems, strengthen internal controls, and scale our finance operations.

The ideal candidate enjoys bringing order to complexity, thrives in a high-growth environment, and takes pride in building accounting systems that are both accurate and scalable.

If you're someone who enjoys building processes, developing people, and creating order in a fast-growing environment, we'd love to meet you.

Why This Role Matters

We're growing rapidly, and finance plays a central role in that growth. This position offers the opportunity to shape how our accounting organization scales over the coming years—not simply maintain what's already in place. If you're energized by building systems, developing people, and improving processes, you'll have a meaningful impact here.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Lead month-end and year-end close processes in accordance with GAAP.
  • Oversee financial reporting across multiple entities and investment funds.
  • Ensure accurate investor distributions and financial reporting.
  • Build scalable accounting processes and strong internal controls.
  • Partner with acquisitions, operations, and executive leadership to provide financial insights that support strategic decision-making.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing accounting team.
  • Coordinate with external auditors and tax professionals.
  • Continuously improve systems and workflows as our portfolio grows.

What Makes 52TEN Different?

  • The Best Experience. We believe great companies start with great teams. We celebrate wins, support each other, and strive to create the best experience for everyone we work with.
  • True Remote Work. Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote environment with autonomy to manage your schedule and do your best work from anywhere.
  • Unlimited PTO (That You’re Encouraged to Take). We believe balance matters. Our unlimited PTO policy is designed to help you recharge and bring your best self to work.
  • A World-Class Team. We hire growth-minded individuals who care deeply about collaboration, learning, and delivering exceptional results together.

Why Work With 52TEN?

At 52TEN, culture is one of the most defining aspects of our success. We’re a fast-paced, goal-oriented company that runs on the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS), giving our team clear priorities, accountability, and the ability to execute at a high level.

At the same time, we believe work should complement your life—not consume it. As a fully remote team, we provide the flexibility, autonomy, and trust needed for our people to do meaningful work while maintaining balance.

While each team member brings unique expertise and responsibilities, collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We rally around shared goals, support one another, and work together to deliver the best experience for our investors, partners, residents, and team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting leadership experience
  • Real estate or property management accounting experience required
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP muti-entity accounting
  • Experience leading accounting teams
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with accounting software

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license
  • Experience with property management accounting systems such as Rent Manager
  • Experience in process improvement and accounting system optimization
  • Familiarity with real estate investment structures

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary Range: $120,000-$145,000 depending on experience
  • Performance-based bonus opportunity
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Company paid holidays
  • Group medical, dental, and vision, and life insurance
  • Technology reimbursement

Who We Are at 52TEN

  • A high-performing team with the agility of a boutique company and the capability of a large one
  • Forward-thinking and tech-savvy, always seeking smarter ways to work
  • Deeply collaborative—both at our communities and across the company
  • Committed to investing in our people, equipping you with the tools to thrive in your role and grow beyond it

Who We’re Not

  • We’re not stuck in old ways of thinking or focused only on the bottom line
  • We don’t forget that we’re people first—with families, ambitions, and values
  • We don’t shy away from challenges or growth—we welcome them
  • We don’t avoid accountability or repeat mistakes—we learn and evolve
  • We don’t operate in silos—we win as one team

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you. Thanks for considering 52TEN as part of your career journey!


Equal Employment Opportunity

52TEN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Physical Requirements

This is primarily a remote, sedentary position requiring extended periods of sitting and computer use. The ability to communicate effectively, view computer screens, and occasionally lift or move items up to 20 pounds may be required. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Job Title: Chief Analytics Officer (CAO)

Role Summary

The Chief Analytics Officer leads the organization's analytics strategy, transforming data into actionable insights that drive business performance, innovation, and competitive advantage. This role focuses on advanced analytics, AI/ML, and decision intelligence to enable data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

1. Analytics Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute enterprise-wide analytics strategy aligned with business goals
  • Position analytics as a core driver of growth, efficiency, and innovation
  • Advise executive leadership on insights-driven decision-making

2. Advanced Analytics & AI/ML

  • Lead development of predictive, prescriptive, and machine learning models
  • Drive AI/ML adoption across functions (marketing, risk, operations, finance)
  • Ensure scalability and productionization of analytics models

3. Business Intelligence & Insights

  • Oversee BI platforms, dashboards, and reporting frameworks
  • Enable real-time and self-service analytics across business units
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders

4. Decision Intelligence & Value Creation

  • Embed analytics into business processes and decision workflows
  • Drive measurable impact on revenue growth, cost optimization, and risk management
  • Establish KPIs to track analytics ROI and business outcomes

5. Data Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with the Chief Data Officer and IT teams on data architecture and quality
  • Ensure responsible use of data and adherence to governance frameworks
  • Align analytics initiatives with data strategy and compliance standards

6. Innovation & Experimentation

  • Promote a culture of experimentation (A/B testing, hypothesis-driven analysis)
  • Explore emerging technologies and advanced modeling techniques
  • Drive continuous improvement in analytical capabilities

7. Talent & Capability Building

  • Build and lead high-performing analytics and data science teams
  • Develop analytics capabilities across the organization
  • Promote data literacy and insight-driven culture

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field
  • 15–20+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or quantitative roles
  • Proven track record in delivering analytics-driven business impact
  • Strong expertise in statistical modeling, AI/ML, and BI tools
  • Experience working with executive leadership and cross-functional teams

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and quantitative expertise
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen
  • Ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Leadership and stakeholder influence
  • Innovation and problem-solving mindset

Who we are looking for

Slate is looking for an energetic, organized, experienced Principal UX Designer to join our growing team.

What you get to do

  • The Principal UX Designer will help our customers engage with our vehicle program through clarity of concepts and workflow. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading impactful UX projects in disruptive, ambiguous problem spaces. They will be a part of the team responsible for defining how people interact with Slate products. The ideal candidate will be proficient at establishing User Experience (UX) processes to drive ease of use and consistency across Slate products – in and out of vehicle.

  • The responsibilities of the Principal UX Designer include but are not limited to the following:

  • Build relationships with key partners in Brand, Design and HMI, Engineering and Software teams.

  • Help balance strategic and tactical initiatives, to help ensure the team is solving the most critical user needs.

  • Expertly articulate insights and actionable UX recommendations to executive level stakeholders.

What you bring to the team

  • You bring 10+ years professional work experience leading high impact UX projects.

  • You’re experienced in interface design and evaluation; thorough knowledge and experience of a range of UX approaches and methodologies is a must.

  • You have a passion for emerging technologies, new interaction models, apps, and interactive interfaces.

  • You are a proven strategic thinker and collaborator who flourishes in an ambiguous problem space

  • You actively engage your teammates and proactively initiate new projects.

  • You have excellent interpersonal, organizational, and analytical skills

  • You’re proficient in both writing and speaking the English language

  • You’re proficient with UX design tools such as Figma.

  • You have deep understanding of accessibility and inclusivity in UX.

Preferred Qualifications

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

raw.description:
About the Role:   

The Strategic Sales Advisor provides strategic sales expertise, industry insight, and account support to advance growth within the distribution and fulfillment market. Working closely with the EVP of Solutions & Growth and the broader sales team, this role serves as a trusted advisor on strategic opportunities, customer relationships, and sales effectiveness.

Leveraging extensive experience in the material handling industry, the Strategic Sales Advisor will support select accounts and opportunities, coach and develop sales team members, and provide guidance on complex or high-value pursuits. This role combines strategic advisory support with hands-on customer engagement to strengthen DCS’s sales capabilities and position the organization for continued growth.

In this role, you will:   

  • Partner with the EVP of Solutions & Growth and sales team to providestrategic guidance on key accounts, opportunities, and growth initiatives.
  • Support select distribution and fulfillment accounts, serving as an experienced resource throughout the sales process.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with key customer stakeholders and support the development of long-term strategic partnerships.
  • Participate in customer meetings, presentations, opportunity strategy sessions, and negotiations as needed.
  • Advise sales team members on account strategy, customer engagement, competitive positioning, and complex sales opportunities.
  • Coach and mentor sales team members to strengthen sales effectiveness, industry knowledge, and customer relationship skills.
  • Develop and facilitate training focused on areas such as consultative selling, account development, opportunity strategy, and relationship management.
  • Share industry knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned to support the continued development of the sales organization.
  • Provide insight into customer needs, market trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities within the distribution and fulfillment market.
  • Identify and help develop new customer relationships and potential growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Solutions, Sales, Operations, and other teams to align customer strategies with DCS capabilities.
  • Support strategic and special projects identified by the EVP of Solutions & Growth.
  • Contribute to sales tools, approaches, and best practices that improve consistency and effectiveness across the sales organization.

We’re Excited About You Because:   

  • Extensive experience in sales, business development, account management, or commercial leadership within the material handling industry.
  • Deep understanding of distribution and fulfillment operations and material handling solutions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and managing strategic customer relationships and complex sales opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of consultative and relationship-based selling within a business-to-business environment.
  • Experience coaching, mentoring, training, or developing sales professionals.
  • Ability to provide strategic guidance while remaining actively engaged in customer and opportunity-specific work.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand customer challenges and connect them with potential solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, solutions, operations, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of the material handling industry, competitive landscape, and evolving distribution and fulfillment needs.

This job description is not exhaustive. Other duties may be assigned as needed, and responsibilities may evolve to support the business and employee experience.

About Us:   

Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982 and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.   

And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.

More reasons to join our team:   

  • We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment   
  • We offer competitive salaries and health benefits   
  • Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%   
  • Participation in our Discretionary Profit-Sharing Program   
  • We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy   
  • We do community outreach projects throughout the year   
  • We know how to throw company events   
  • We work hard, but we also know how to have fun - darts, anyone?

Individuals seeking employment at Designed Conveyor Systems are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Accommodation is available to applicants with a disability condition, when applying, testing, or interviewing for a position. Please let us know if you need accommodation.

Position Summary: The Collection Analyst is responsible for supporting the timely collection of outstanding client invoices, maintaining accurate collection records, and partnering with internal teams and clients to resolve payment issues. This role supports cash flow management by proactively monitoring receivables, communicating with clients and project teams, and ensuring follow-up activities are completed in accordance with established collection processes.

Your Responsibilities as a Collection Analyst:

  • Manage the collections for one of the four business units within Apex.
  • Monitor assigned accounts receivable balances and identify past-due invoices requiring follow-up, per the client payment terms.
  • Contact clients regarding outstanding balances, payment status, remittance details, and invoice questions.
  • Collaborate with project managers, project accountants, and other internal teams to resolve collection matters.
  • Record and review collection activity, client responses, payment commitments, and follow-up actions in the appropriate tracking tool.
  • Identify, track and maintain payment portal access for applicable client accounts within the business unit.
  • Review aging reports and prioritize collection efforts based on balance, age, risk, and business needs.
  • Prepare collection updates, reports, and status summaries for management review.
  • Support recurring collection meetings by providing account updates, recommended next steps, and follow-up status.
  • Escalate high-risk accounts, delinquent balances, or unresolved disputes to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain professional client relationships while supporting timely payment and adherence to agreed payment terms.
  • Support demand letter preparation, collection agency submissions, and other escalation procedures as directed.
  • Support process improvements related to collections tracking, reporting, and client communication.

What we're looking for:

  • An associate’s or bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Three or more years of experience in accounts receivable, collections, and customer service.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clients and internal teams.
  • Strong attention to detail when updating and maintaining customer account records.
  • Ability to resolve complex payment issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a timely manner.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and accounting or ERP systems; experience with Deltek Vantagepoint is an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Committed to delivering exceptional customer service and building positive client relationships.
  • Problem-solving skills to resolve issues effectively.
  • Maintains a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Handles financial information responsibly while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Collaborates effectively with internal teams.

Success Measures

  • Reduction in past-due accounts receivable for the assigned business unit.
  • Timely and consistent follow-up on assigned past-due accounts.
  • Accurate and complete documentation of collection activity.
  • Effective coordination with internal teams to resolve payment issues.
  • Professional communication with clients that supports relationships and timely payment.

Why you'll love working for us:

  • Company-subsidized medical and dental.
  • Company-paid life, short, and long-term disability.
  • 401k match, tuition assistance, and more.
  • Cross-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.
  • Performance-based bonuses or other incentives.
  • Working with the best and brightest in the industry.
  • 2,000+ employee national firm with 50+ locations across the US.

Senior Product Marketing Manager - Gateway, Devices & Vertical Solutions

We're looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for NMI's Gateway product line, with a focus on card-present devices and vertical markets such as unattended retail, parking, medical, and beyond.

This role sits at the center of product, sales, and marketing, translating platform and device capabilities into compelling, solution-forward value propositions that resonate with the operators, partners, and buyers within each vertical. You will own market positioning, messaging, launches, and enablement for NMI's Gateway, device, and unattended solutions, ensuring NMI is the preferred payments partner across every vertical it serves.

This role requires a strong understanding of how vertical markets evaluate and adopt payment technology, and the ability to explain the value proposition and competitive advantages of NMI's solutions in terms that matter to each vertical, not just the technical specifications of the hardware or gateway itself. You'll help shape how partners, integrators and operators in card-present verticals, in particular the unattended (transportation, parking, vending, etc) space, and understand, evaluate, and succeed with NMI, while supporting revenue teams with clear, differentiated, outcome-focused messaging that drives pipeline and adoption. Success in this role looks like partners, integrators and operators understanding how NMI's applications help their business succeed, not a list of device features.

This role is also NMI's evangelist for these solutions. You'll present directly to sales teams, internal and external stakeholders, and prospects, and represent NMI at trade shows, conferences, and other industry events, including external speaking opportunities and briefings with industry analysts. You'll build AI tools into your everyday workflow as a core habit rather than an occasional add-on, and bring enough technical depth across gateways, devices, APIs, and certification processes to hold your own in a room with engineers and technical buyers, not just repeat what they tell you.

About Us

NMI develops the most trusted payment software for mobile, online and in-store that is relied on in 38 countries, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. With offices in Chicago, New York, Cape Town SA, and Bristol UK, our payment technology powers millions of customers worldwide, ensuring they can take payments worth billions, securely and reliably. You've probably used our software when ordering a burger, paying for parking, buying something online or booking a train ticket, without even realizing it!

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We're focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group, diversity goals for hiring, anonymized resume screening, affinity groups such as our Women's Network and LGBTQ+ Network, open forums for discussions on diversity and social justice, and measuring inclusion and belonging as part of our regular employee engagement surveys.

Responsibilities

  • Own Gateway, Device & Vertical Go-to-Market Strategy
    • Lead positioning and messaging for NMI's Gateway product line across device and vertical segments, including medical, unattended retail, parking, and other emerging verticals.
    • Define clear, solution-forward value propositions for each vertical's buyers and operators, grounded in the business outcomes NMI's applications enable and revenue generation rather than device or technical specifications alone.
    • Develop differentiated narratives that articulate why NMI is the payments partner of choice for each vertical, moving away from feature-and-spec language in favor of stories about partner and operator success.
    • Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap decisions using vertical market insight and competitive intelligence. Be the customer and go-to-market expert who drives adoption of our Gateway and device solutions.
  • Drive Product Launches & Market Adoption
    • Lead end-to-end go-to-market execution for new Gateway features, devices, and vertical-specific enhancements.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally across product, sales, corporate marketing, and channel marketing to ensure successful launch execution.
    • Create launch plans, enablement materials, customer-facing messaging, and internal readiness programs that speak to each vertical's priorities and pain points.
    • Support adoption and revenue generation by aligning messaging with onboarding, documentation, and the operator experience within each vertical.
  • Deeply Understand Vertical & Device Ecosystems
    • Serve as the in-house expert on buyer and operator personas within medical, unattended, parking, transportation and other priority verticals.
    • Conduct market research to understand trends in device commerce, unattended retail, vertical-specific regulation, and payment application monetization.
    • Monitor competitors and evolving vertical market dynamics to refine NMI's differentiation strategy.
    • Translate ecosystem shifts into actionable, solution-focused messaging and strategic recommendations.
  • Build Sales & Channel Enablement
    • Develop high-impact sales enablement tools, including pitch decks, battlecards, case studies, messaging frameworks, ROI narratives, and vertical-specific solution narratives and use cases.
    • Help sales articulate the business value of NMI's Gateway and device solutions in terms each vertical's buyers care about, not just technical capability.
    • Support lifecycle messaging that drives adoption, expansion, and retention among partners across verticals.
    • Partner with channel marketing to equip ISOs, software integrators, and reseller partners with compelling, vertical-focused messaging they can use with confidence.
  • Be an Evangelist for NMI's Solutions
    • Present NMI's Gateway, device, and vertical solutions to sales teams, internal and external stakeholders, partners and prospects, turning positioning into a compelling live narrative that lands in the room.
    • Represent NMI at trade shows, industry events, and conferences, and pursue external speaking opportunities that build NMI's credibility and visibility in the verticals it serves.
    • Build relationships with industry analysts and serve as a credible, technical voice for NMI's Gateway and device story.
    • Bring working technical fluency across gateways, devices, APIs, and certification processes, deep enough to hold your own with engineers, integrators, and technical buyers.
  • Influence Product & Business Strategy
    • Use competitive insight and vertical customer research to influence product packaging, pricing, and positioning decisions.
    • Build business cases to support new vertical market opportunities.
    • Drive alignment across product, engineering, and commercial teams around priority verticals and growth strategy.
    • Success looks like: clear, differentiated positioning across each vertical NMI serves; strong adoption of new Gateway and device launches; increased pipeline contribution and revenue impact from vertical solutions; sales teams confidently articulating NMI's value in each vertical's terms; and product decisions informed by real vertical customer and market insight.
  • Drive Thought Leadership & Solution Storytelling
    • Synthesize vertical customer and market insights into repeatable narratives and frameworks for internal and external use.
    • Partner with content and comms to produce thought leadership (whitepapers, POVs, benchmark reports, keynotes, webinars) centered on how NMI's solutions help each vertical succeed.
    • Contribute to company and industry initiatives (webinars, events, analysts, partners) relevant to priority verticals.

Experience

  • 5-8+ years of B2B product marketing experience in payments, fintech, devices/hardware-enabled commerce, or vertical SaaS.
  • Direct experience marketing payment gateways, devices, or unattended/vertical solutions (e.g., unattended retail, kiosks, vending, parking, medical, or similar verticals).
  • Strong ability to translate technical or device capabilities into solution-forward, outcome-based messaging for non-technical operators and buyers.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional product and device launches.
  • Ability to move a product's narrative from feature and spec-led to solution and outcome-led, and to bring sales and channel teams along with that shift.
  • Experience supporting both direct sales and channel/reseller (ISO) go-to-market motions.
  • Comfortable and effective presenting live to sales teams, prospects, and internal/external stakeholders, including at trade shows, conferences, and analyst briefings.
  • Uses AI tools as an integrated part of daily PMM work (research, content, competitive analysis, enablement production), not as an occasional add-on.
  • Strong storytelling, messaging, speaking and content development skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or other related field, MBA a plus.

Essential Skills

  • Strategist - You combine classic strategic marketing skills with experience in multi-channel marketing/distribution, have perspective, and can see and discuss multiple aspects and impacts of issues and project them into the future.
  • Strong external and internal leader - You collaborate well cross-functionally with key internal partners, work effectively with external partners to identify potential joint marketing opportunities, and have a willingness to learn and coach.
  • Business Savvy - You possess a technical understanding of devices, gateways, and the payments space, have a high degree of business acumen, and provide consistent, accurate information.
  • Master Communicator - You have the ability to distill complex and difficult information into easy to understand communications. In other words, you can easily "de-geek the speak" with your exceptional creative and communication skills.
  • Influencer - You have demonstrated superior relationship-building and influence management skills in interactions with senior leaders, peers, internal and external partners.
  • Flexible - You not only cope with change, you thrive on it and can shift gears comfortably.
  • Driven - You are results-oriented with a positive outlook and a clear focus on quality and business performance.
  • Solution Oriented - You have the ability to identify and creatively solve complex problems.
  • Personable - You are positive, energetic, and exude a strong sense of teamwork by working effectively, respectfully, and efficiently with all team members.
  • Courageous and Ethical - You possess professional courage, steadfastly persevere through challenges, are ambitious while humble, have high standards for ethics and integrity, and do the right things the right way.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience marketing into unattended retail, parking, medical/healthcare, or other device-driven verticals.
  • Experience with payment gateways, terminals, or IoT/connected device commerce.
  • Experience managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience shifting a product's go-to-market from a technical, spec-driven story to a solution and outcome-driven story.
  • Experience working with ISOs, resellers, or channel partners on vertical-specific enablement.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • Annual bonus scheme dependent on individual and company performance
  • Annual salary of £75,000 - £100,000
  • 25 days holiday each year (+ bank holidays + 1 day after each year of service with up to a max. of 30 days)
  • Workplace pension scheme
  • Private medical insurance (upon 30 days of employment)
  • 7 hours per day, 35 hours per week
  • A remote first culture
  • Great work-life balance with our Flexi-time policy

  • Bike2Work Scheme
  • Lifeworks, an Employee Assistance Programme which offers wellbeing, family and financial support services, such as assessments, resources and even 1:1 counselling sessions. It also offers interesting perks such as discounts on gyms, restaurants, high street retailers and cinema tickets
  • A strong commitment to employee wellbeing including mental health first aiders
  • Employee referral scheme with generous financial reward
  • Bonusly colleague reward scheme

raw.excerpt: As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead customer discovery and strategy for IFS Copperleaf Asset Investment Planning platform, serving 140+ enterprise customers across electric utilities, water and wastewater, natural gas, and transportation asset-intensive industries.
raw.description:
As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead customer discovery and strategy for IFS Copperleaf Asset Investment Planning platform, serving 140+ enterprise customers across electric utilities, water and wastewater, natural gas, and transportation asset-intensive industries. The urgency around capital planning has intensified: aging infrastructure, regulatory mandates, re-industrialization, onshoring, and data-center expansion are all competing for limited capital. Our platform helps utilities and infrastructure operators model investment scenarios, optimize capital allocation, and make evidence-based decisions at the pace and scale these challenges demand.

Your role bridges customer insight and product strategy globally. You will spend 25% of your time forward-deployed with customers across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Australia, engaging at user summits and IFS Connect events. You will gather feedback from customers and partners, validate product direction, and translate evidence into roadmap strategy. The remaining 75% of your time, you will drive product strategy, manage cross-functional execution with Design, Engineering, and Customer Success teams, and own the investment case and market analysis for your product area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct customer discovery and co-creation at 140+ enterprise accounts across utilities and asset-intensive sectors. Understand workflows, regulatory constraints, capital planning processes, and investment priorities.
  • Work forward-deployed with customers (25% travel) across global regions. Validate solutions in real-world contexts and translate evidence into product strategy.
  • Engage with customers at regional and global user summits and IFS Connect events to gather feedback, validate roadmap direction, and strengthen relationships.
  • Work directly with our partner ecosystem including systems integrators and consultants. Ensure partners have the tools, documentation, and support to deliver and enable our platform.
  • Partner with Design and UX teams to ensure features are intuitive, user-centric, and solve real problems for regulated utilities.
  • Own the commercial and strategic case for your product area: market analysis, competitive positioning, financial projections, and customer value models.
  • Translate customer and partner evidence into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap that balances customer needs, business impact, and market opportunity.
  • Define clear, testable requirements and acceptance criteria based on customer validation.
  • Drive go-to-market readiness through positioning, sales plays, partner enablement, and customer success support tailored to utilities' long sales cycles.
  • Close commitments on agreed dates, hold quality standards, and make decisions about when to ship versus iterate.

Required:

  • 3-6+ years of product management experience in B2B enterprise software, depending on career level.
  • Proven customer discovery and co-creation capability; comfort working embedded with customers.
  • Strong collaboration with Design and UX teams; demonstrated experience in user-centric product development.
  • Understanding of regulated, asset-intensive industries or demonstrated ability to develop this knowledge quickly.
  • Comfort with long enterprise sales cycles (12-24 months) and regulated organization stakeholder complexity.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

Frontier coding agents are already good at passing tests. We measure whether they pass them the right way.We're building a dataset to evaluate the safety and conduct of AI coding agents — not just whether they complete a task, but whether they do it honestly, within scope, and without cutting corners.You'll design tasks where the easy path is the unsafe one, and write the tests that catch it:

  • Build realistic developer environments — a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks that pair a benign development goal with a tempting unsafe shortcut: scope creep, policy violations, data corruption, over-permissive changes
  • Write tests that verify whether the agent completed the task the right way — catching corners cut, not just checking outputs
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback — review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling;
  • Not prompt engineering;
  • Not cybersecurity or red-teaming — there is no attacker in the scenario. Cybersecurity experience is a nice-to-have but not a requirement. We're looking for engineers who understand how code should behave, not penetration testers. Strong software engineers, not security specialists;
  • Not writing code from scratch — the agent writes most of the code; you design the situation and evaluate the outcome;

What we look for

  • 4–5+ years in software development;
  • Core stack: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Strong test design skills — functional and integration tests that separate safe from unsafe completion, not just correct from incorrect;
  • Hands-on experience with coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex, or similar);
  • Familiarity with GitHub PRs and CI workflows as a user;
  • Stack breadth is welcome, not a filter. Tasks simulate real repositories with databases, CI pipelines, and deploy scripts, so wider backend and infrastructure exposure is genuinely useful — but you don't need to be an expert in every layer;
  • English proficiency — B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. The real difficulty is building the temptation — a scenario where the unsafe or out-of-scope path is the path of least resistance — and then writing tests that reliably catch an agent that took it. Tasks have many valid solutions; tests must accept all of them and reject the bad ones.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 20-25 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $75 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
En Product Hackers estamos construyendo el mejor equipo de Growth del mundo. Personas altamente creativas, inteligentes e ingeniosas pero con mente científica y absoluta obsesión por los productos digitales. Queremos ser el Space X del Growth, por eso buscamos a los mejores humanos, con las mejores capacidades para convertirlos en astronautas.

Si quieres sumergirte en el universo de los productos digitales, visitar los planetas de nuestros clientes (sus productos digitales) y terraformarlos para que puedan albergar vida (usuarios y clientes) este es el lugar ideal para pasar de ser un mísero humano a un astronauta del producto digital. Sí, también somos muy frikis del espacioX y esas cosas.

🚀 Además, en Product Hackers encontrarás un equipo que aprende y comparte constantemente, que busca que las ideas se experimenten, se prueben y se implementen sin miedo, porque aquí compartimos aprendizajes, crecemos juntos gracias a esta pasión por el Growth

Somos remote-first y contamos con grandes profesionales de diferentes puntos del mundo.

¿CUÁL ES TU MISIÓN?

Como Growth Analytics Engineer, tu misión será que el dato del que dependen las decisiones sea fiable: instrumentar bien desde el principio, auditar lo que ya existe y dejar la medición preparada para experimentar. Trabajarás sobre e-commerce y producto, y con equipos que necesitan leer resultados sin dudar de los números.

Aquí no vas a trabajar solo con herramientas de terceros: tenemos plataforma propia de experimentación y un entorno de agentes con MCPs que usamos a diario para auditar y analizar.

¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?

  • Etiquetado de eventos en GTM para GA4 y otras herramientas de analítica.

  • Configuraciones avanzadas en GA4 para clientes.

  • Diseño de exploraciones en GA4 y de los cuadros de mando que las acompañan.

  • Creación de informes de resultados en Data Studioy Power BI.

  • Ejecución de auditoría de instrumentación para cada nuevo cliente.

  • Diseño y liderazgo de los planes de medición y de las taxonomías de eventos entre plataformas (web, app, servidor)

  • Referente técnico de instrumentación de experimentos para los equipos internos y los stakeholders de los proyectos en los que participa.

  • Implantación y revisión del consentimiento en la medición (Consent Mode v2, CMPs) y explicación de su efecto sobre los datos.

  • Instrumentación y validación de experimentos: que la variante quede registrada, que el reparto de muestra sea correcto y que no haya huecos de datos entre la herramienta de test y GA4.

  • Conciliación de datos entre la plataforma de e-commerce y GA4: detectar discrepancias en sesiones, pedidos e ingresos, encontrar la causa y proponer el arreglo.

¿QUÉ TE HARÁ TRIUNFAR CON NOSOTROS?
Hard skills

  • Tener experiencia de +3años:

    • Instrumentando e-commerce sobre Shopify o plataforma equivalente: dataLayer, eventos de funnel y de compra, convivencia del contenedor de GTM con el custom pixel, y las limitaciones del checkout.

  • Tener experiencia de 2 años en:

    • Entornos ágiles.

    • Creación de dashboards para clientes.

    • Gestión eficaz de tareas y proyectos complejos.

    • Jira, Trello, Asana o similar.

  • Contar con altas habilidades de análisis en GA4

  • Tener capacidad avanzada de instrumentar conGoogle Tag Manager.

  • Ser capaz de crear dashboards avanzados en Data Studio y Power BI.

  • Iniciativa en documentación: dejar por escrito el plan de medición, las decisiones técnicas y los checklists de QA, de modo que otra persona pueda continuar tu trabajo sin preguntarte.

  • Experiencia con herramientas de experimentación(VWO, Optimizely o AB Tasty) por el lado del dato: etiquetado de variantes, control de muestra y lectura de resultados.

  • Consent Mode v2 y CMPsy su efecto real sobre el dato: modelado, huecos de atribución y tráfico sin asignar.

  • Uso deIA en el día a día de analítica: agentes y MCPs para auditar instrumentaciones, acelerar análisis y automatizar QA. No buscamos conocimiento teórico, buscamos que ya lo estés usando en tu trabajo.

  • SQL sobre BigQuery a nivel intermedio: agregaciones y JOIN, y manejo de la exportación de GA4 (estructuras anidadas, event_params, UNNEST), con control del coste de las consultas.

  • Inglés B2

Soft Skills

  • Adaptabilidad al cambio.

  • Carácter autodidacta.

  • Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.

  • Excelentes habilidades comunicativas (especialmente a nivel escrito).

  • Criterio técnico y capacidad de sostenerlo. Saber decir que una implementación no es fiable y explicar por qué con datos, aunque quien la propone sea el cliente.

ADEMÁS, SERÁ IDEAL SI TÚ...

  • Tienes conocimientos de:

    • HTML, CSS y JS.

    • Adobe Analytics y Adobe Launch, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Quantum Metric y herramientas similares.

    • Python, R.

    • Etiquetado en servidor (GTM server side, Stape o similar) y conexión de Shopify con herramientas de CRM o email (Klaviyo o equivalentes)

  • Cuentas con experiencia en:

    • gestión de píxeles de tracking de servicios de ads.

    • Instrumentación de apps móviles: SDK de Firebase/GA4 para app, eventos y propiedades de usuario, y validación con DebugView.

¿CÓMO SERÁN TUS PRIMEROS MESES EN PRODUCT HACKERS?

  • El primer mes 📆: Durante las primeras semanas, nos aseguraremos de que conozcas el funcionamiento de Product Hackers y sobre todo de nuestro método. El equipo, los valores que compartimos. Tendrás oportunidad de analizar el funcionamiento actual de la metodología, las herramientas que utilizamos y comenzarás a aportar ideas de mejora. ¡Todos los aportes son bienvenidos!

  • El primer trimestre🌱: Te familiarizarás con los procesos internos y con las demandas externas con el apoyo de todo el equipo. Poco a poco se irán notando las mejoras que comencemos a trabajar y te encontrarás liderando la comunicación con nuestros clientes. Estarás gestionando de inicio a fin al menos un proyecto con cliente

  • A la luna 🚀: Product Hackers te proporcionará las herramientas, pero tú serás capaz de desarrollarte tanto de manera profesional como personal, integrando todos los aprendizajes y siendo capaz de aportar un valor añadido tanto a tus responsabilidades como a las de otros equipos. Estamos en constante crecimiento, así que para este momento, seguramente tus responsabilidades y roles se hayan enriquecido bastante.

¿QUÉ BENEFICIOS PODRÁS ENCONTRAR?

  • Equipo 👨‍👨‍👧‍👧: Un equipo que trabaja de manera remota pero cercana y con la mejor vibra, que está dispuesto a ayudar en todo momento y que comparte la pasión por el Growth. Encontrarás un equipo que tiene muchas habilidades y asumiendo diferentes roles del cual siempre podrás echar una mano y aprender.

  • Crecimiento personal y profesional 🔭 :La curva de aprendizaje puede ser dura al inicio, pero una vez que despegas, el progreso es muy rápido y se nota. El crecimiento de Growth Hackers y su proyección es posible gracias a sus astronautas

  • Método propio 👾: Hacemos algo especial, algo que no está en todos lados, nos salimos del tradicionalismo y probamos cosas nuevas ya que estamos en un sector que se mueve muy rápido. ¡Qué mejor que aprendas el método y puedas aplicarlo a tu propio negocio!

TE OFRECEMOS
