raw.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This position can work onsite or hybrid from one of our offices in the US or fully remote.
Travel: Up to 10%
Job ID: 1752

The Role:

We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator, Federal to join our Revenue Operations team. As a Salesforce Administrator, you will be part of a cross-functional team whose mission is to lead IonQ on its journey to build the world's best quantum computers to solve the world's most complex problems.

In this role, you will own the health, configuration, and compliance posture of IonQ's Salesforce Government Cloud environment supporting our federal business. You will provision and govern access, deliver enhancements, and keep the platform audit-ready against federal control frameworks. The ideal candidate is a hands-on administrator who is meticulous about access control and data integrity, comfortable operating in a regulated environment, and able to work independently in a fast-moving, resource-constrained team.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and administer IonQ's Salesforce Government Cloud org, ensuring the environment is configured correctly, segmented from commercial orgs, and continuously aligned to FedRAMP and CUI handling requirements.
  • Provision and deprovision user access, managing profiles, permission sets, roles, and license assignments in line with least-privilege and federal access-governance standards.
  • Build and deliver enhancements using declarative tools (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, dynamic forms) and coordinate managed-package and integration changes within GovCloud constraints.
  • Design, build, and maintain reports and dashboards that give federal sales, operations, and compliance stakeholders accurate, timely visibility into pipeline and activity.
  • Perform routine platform maintenance including data-quality management, deduplication, sandbox and release management, and evaluation of seasonal Salesforce updates before they reach production.
  • Support Salesforce Shield controls (platform encryption, event monitoring, field audit trail) and produce the access reviews and evidence required for CMMC, NIST 800-171, and internal audit.
  • Manage the intake queue for federal Salesforce requests, triaging, prioritizing, and resolving issues against agreed service levels.
  • Gather requirements from federal stakeholders, translate them into configuration or solution designs, and lead UAT before deployment.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and configuration standards so the environment stays supportable and transferable.
  • Serve as the subject-matter expert for federal Salesforce, advising on best practices and partnering with security, trade compliance, and IT on ITAR and CUI data-handling questions.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a Salesforce administrator, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Active Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM-201) and demonstrated mastery of the declarative platform, including the security model, permission sets, flows, report types, and page layouts.
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a regulated or compliance-driven environment, with working knowledge of access governance and audit support.
  • Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident) and able to meet the requirements for handling CUI and working within a Salesforce Government Cloud / FedRAMP environment.
  • Strong data-management skills, including data quality, imports, and deduplication.
  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a small, fast-moving team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator (ADM-211) or Platform App Builder certification.
  • Direct experience with Salesforce Government Cloud, Salesforce Shield, and FedRAMP-authorized environments.
  • Familiarity with federal compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800-171, DFARS, ITAR/CUI) as they apply to CRM.
  • Experience supporting a federal or public-sector sales organization, including deal desk or RevOps processes.
  • Exposure to Revenue Cloud/CPQ, Agentforce, or Salesforce integrations in a multi-business-unit environment.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment where processes are still being built.

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

Wage Transparency:
$128,445—$183,450 USD

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

US Non-Technical Jobs. Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. raw.description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 11 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million Gradio apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Roles at Hugging Face are very fluid and dynamic -- we're looking for someone who is comfortable taking on different challenges that evolve over time. This role sits on the Xet Storage team, the group responsible for the storage system behind all of Hugging Face. Today we store over 200PB (and growing rapidly!) of the world's most important ML & AI assets. Xet is the underlying storage architecture for the entire Hugging Face platform and community -- from the largest model repositories to the datasets and Spaces that millions of people build on every day.

In this role, you'll work across two closely connected surfaces. You'll contribute to xet-core, our open-source project written in Rust that powers hf-xet -- the Python library underpinning the Hugging Face Hub client and the wider ecosystem of open-source tools the community relies on. And you'll design, build, and operate meaningful and challenging features in the Xet Storage backend, contributing to the broader Infrastructure organization at Hugging Face. We're a small team building and operating incredible things at enormous scale, in a high-trust, low-process, async, and remote environment -- and we lean heavily on the latest AI tools to move fast.

If you love writing low-level, high-performance code and are energized by the challenge of large-scale, scalable services, this is the team for you. This usually means proven experience building and operating production systems software, but we consider every applicant on an individual basis.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years building and scaling distributed systems, storage, or networking infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in a low-level systems language, with Rust strongly preferred (we also work in Python, Typescript, Go, and C++ across the stack).
  • A track record of working independently in a high-trust, low-process environment -- you're comfortable with ambiguity and take ownership end to end.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, async, and fully remote environment.
  • A passion for building simple, robust, and scalable systems relied on by engineering and science teams around the world.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience designing efficient, high-performance, fault-tolerant data storage and retrieval systems.
  • Experience operating production systems -- monitoring, alerting, and distributed debugging and recovery.
  • Familiarity with git internals, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes), databases (relational and non-relational), or networking.

About You

If you love open-source, are excited by the intersection of low-level performance work and large-scale services, and want your code to sit at the foundation of the world's largest platform for AI builders, then we can't wait to see your application!

If you're interested in joining us, but don't tick every box above, we still encourage you to apply! We're building a diverse team whose skills, experiences, and backgrounds complement one another. We're happy to consider where you might be able to make the biggest impact.

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

We support the community. We believe major scientific advancements are the result of collaboration across the field. Join a community supporting the ML/AI community.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data & Integration Architect to design and govern enterprise data models, integration flows, data contracts, and event-driven architectures that support mission-critical systems including CMS, E-EFMP, analytics platforms, and API ecosystems. This senior role ensures that data structures, pipelines, and integration patterns are secure, scalable, interoperable, and aligned with DoD and IL5 cloud requirements.

The Data & Integration Architect collaborates closely with application architects, API engineers, cloud architects, analytics teams, and cybersecurity personnel to ensure enterprise-wide consistency across data, integration, and shared information flows.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Data & Integration Architect will:

  • Design enterprise data models, schemas, and data contracts for cross-system interoperability.
  • Architect integration flows across CMS, E-EFMP, analytics systems, APIs, and shared services.
  • Lead design of ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation logic, and data ingestion processes.
  • Develop event-driven architectures leveraging queues, messaging, and asynchronous workflows.
  • Govern data mapping, lineage tracking, metadata strategy, and data quality standards.
  • Collaborate with API architects to ensure consistent data contracts across integration layers.
  • Define standards for data exchange, payload formatting, versioning, and schema evolution.
  • Ensure all data and integration designs align with IL5 cloud security, RMF controls, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Oversee data migration planning, modernization strategy, and cross-system interface redesigns.
  • Support analytics teams with data modeling, warehouse integration, and dataset provisioning.
  • Produce enterprise data architecture documents, diagrams, and reference materials.
  • Participate in architecture review boards, modernization planning, and cross-team technical discussions.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in data architecture, integration engineering, or enterprise system architecture.
  • Experience designing data models, ETL pipelines, and event-driven data architectures.
  • Experience supporting cross-system integrations, API data flows, or large-scale data ecosystems.
  • Experience designing modern data architectures in federal or DoD mission environments.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of enterprise data modeling, schema design, and metadata strategies.
  • Experience designing integration workflows using APIs, messaging, and middleware platforms.
  • Knowledge of ETL/ELT tools, pipelines, and data transformation frameworks.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures (pub/sub, message queues, streaming platforms).
  • Strong familiarity with AWS GovCloud IL5 data services and secure cloud architectures.
  • Knowledge of DoD cybersecurity requirements, RMF controls, and Zero Trust data protection.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with modern data platforms (Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent).
  • Experience with API gateways, microservices, or service mesh architecture.
  • Experience with data cataloging, lineage tracking, or governance tools.

Certifications

Required:

  • ITIL v4 Foundation
  • CompTIA Security+

Preferred:

  • AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)
  • Data architecture or engineering certifications
  • CISSP, CISM, or other advanced security certifications

Skills

  • Strong analytical and systems-thinking abilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and mission teams.
  • High attention to detail with strong documentation discipline.
  • Ability to design complex data and integration solutions spanning multiple systems.
  • Strong leadership and ability to drive enterprise-wide data architecture alignment.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

raw.description:
Pipeline Manager

About the Role

Every deal in our pipeline represents a prospect who raised their hand and said they're interested. Too many of those deals are dying — not because the prospect said no, but because we lost momentum. Follow-ups get delayed, next steps go stale, AEs get busy with new demos and forget to circle back, and deals that should have closed quietly slip away.

The Sales Pipeline Lead exists to make sure that stops happening. You are a player-coach who lives inside Pipedrive, monitors every active deal across all three sales squads, and personally intervenes when deals start stalling. You call prospects directly. You jump on calls with AEs. You catch deals that are scoped wrong before they close and create problems downstream. You hold AEs accountable for follow-up cadence and pipeline hygiene — not through reports, but by being in the pipeline with them daily.

Responsibilities

    What You'll Do

    Monitor Pipedrive daily across all three sales squads. Identify deals that are stalling, aging past expected timelines, or missing recent activity. Take action the same day — not next week.

    Personally intervene on stalling deals. Call prospects directly to re-engage. Re-frame the value proposition. Address objections the AE couldn't overcome. Join AE calls when a second voice or senior presence could move the deal forward.

    Hold AEs accountable for follow-up cadence. Every qualified deal should have a defined next step and a recent touchpoint. If an AE has a deal sitting untouched for 48+ hours, you flag it immediately and ensure action is taken.

    Catch incorrectly scoped deals before they close. Review deals approaching close to verify the prospect is on the right plan, the expectations are set correctly, and the deal won't create problems post-sale. If something is off, intervene before it closes — not after.

    Coordinate with the Solutions Expert to warm hesitant prospects. When a prospect is interested but not yet convinced, arrange pre-close work extraction or other value demonstrations that show them what working with Wing actually looks like.

    Run weekly pipeline health reports. Report to leadership on conversion rates by stage and by AE, deal velocity, deals rescued, deals lost and why, and patterns in pipeline fall-through. Identify systemic issues and recommend fixes.

    Coach AEs on deal management. This is not classroom training — it's in-the-moment coaching. After you rescue a deal, walk the AE through what happened and what they should do differently next time. Your goal is to make yourself less needed over time.

Requirements

    What You'll Need

    3-5 years of B2B sales experience with a track record of personally closing deals, not just managing a pipeline from a distance. You know how to pick up the phone and move a deal forward.

    Experience in a player-coach or senior AE role where you were responsible for both your own deals and helping others close theirs.

    Deep comfort with CRM systems — Pipedrive strongly preferred. You should be able to read a pipeline view and immediately identify which deals need attention without someone telling you.

    Strong phone presence and objection handling skills. You will be talking to prospects daily — often prospects who have gone cold or are hesitating.

    Assertive but collaborative working style. You need to hold AEs accountable without creating friction. You're their coach, not their adversary.

    High urgency. Deals die from delay. You operate with a same-day mentality — if something needs attention, it gets attention now.

    Analytical mindset. You can spot patterns in pipeline data: which stages are leaking, which AEs are struggling, which lead sources produce deals that stall.

    Nice to Have

    Experience in virtual staffing, SaaS or managed services industry.

    Familiarity with Pipedrive reporting and automation features.

    Track record of improving pipeline conversion rates in a previous role.

    Experience working alongside Solutions Engineers, Solutions Experts, or pre-sale technical resources.

Team: Go-To-Market

Position Overview

Virtualitics is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sales Account Executive to join our Federal Sales team and Go-To-Market (GTM) Organization. This individual will be a key driver of our growth within the Department of War(DoW), focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications that directly impact military readiness. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, aggressive and outcome oriented, with a proven track record of selling complex AI software solutions into the DoW space and a deep understanding of the challenges facing the Dept. of War in areas of sustainment, logistics, and operational availability. Reporting directly to the Sales Director within GTM Organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Drive the entire sales process from initial prospecting and opportunity identification to contract negotiation and closing. Build and manage a robust sales pipeline to meet and exceed annual sales targets & Qtrly deal stage KPI’s.

  • Sales Account Management: Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to penetrate key DoD agencies and commands. Identify key stakeholders, understand their challenges, and map our solutions to their critical readiness missions.

  • Customer Relationship Building: Establish and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and end-users within the DoW.

  • Solution-Oriented Selling: Act as a trusted advisor to clients by deeply understanding their specific readiness needs across various domains, including:

    • Aircraft, ship, and ground vehicle asset availability and sustainment operations.

    • Medical device and personnel readiness of the total force.

    • Materiel storage, warehousing management, and supply chain logistics for specialized equipment.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Virtualitics pre-sales engineering/solutions, marketing, Acct Mgmt, and product teams to create and deliver compelling demonstrations, proposals, and RFI/RFP responses that effectively communicate our value proposition.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay current on DoD trends, procurement processes, and competitive landscape to effectively position Virtualitics' solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Required:

    • 7+ years of successful experience in a quota-carrying Federal Account Executive role, with a strong preference for experience within the DoW..

    • Demonstrated experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, or similar complex technology solutions.

    • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans and manage complex sales cycles. Strong understanding of procurement & contracting for AI software acquisition process.

    • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate a complex value proposition to a technical and non-technical audience.

    • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

    • Willingness to travel 40-50% as required to engage with DoD agencies and commands.

  • Preferred:

    • Existing relationships within DoW logistics, sustainment, or readiness communities (e.g., USAF Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC), Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Air Force Sustainment Center (AFSC) , Air Combat Command (ACC) , Air Mobility Command (AMC) , Space Operations Command (SpOC), Air Force Chief Data Office / DoD CDAO AFWERX / DIU / Rapid Capabilities Office)

    • Understanding of government contracting and procurement vehicles.

    • Experience with MEDDIC/MEDPIC, Challenger, or other solution-selling methodologies.

    • Active security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (interim and/or final). Continued employment is contingent upon the successful adjudication of this clearance; failure to obtain or maintain the required level of access may result in rescission of the job offer or termination of employment.

Compensation

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary based on experience

  • Lucrative Commission Plan (50/50 sales plan)

  • 100% employer paid health benefit premiums (medical, dental, vision)

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Paid Time Off for National Holidays

  • Stock options at sign-on

  • 401k plan

  • Company equipment (Mac/PC and iPhone)

  • Remote work from home

About Us

Virtualitics, the Mission AI Company, is focused on readiness applications primarily for defense and national security. We are a rapidly growing small business built on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL. We transform mission readiness and operational efficiencies at speed and scale by reshaping how to approach complex data environments. Our AI solutions provide essential insights that address critical national security capability gaps within operational readiness: Maintenance, Materiel, Supply Chain, Personnel, Data Modernization and Deep Threat Analysis.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

Frontier coding agents are already good at passing tests. We measure whether they pass them the right way.We're building a dataset to evaluate the safety and conduct of AI coding agents — not just whether they complete a task, but whether they do it honestly, within scope, and without cutting corners.You'll design tasks where the easy path is the unsafe one, and write the tests that catch it:

  • Build realistic developer environments — a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks that pair a benign development goal with a tempting unsafe shortcut: scope creep, policy violations, data corruption, over-permissive changes
  • Write tests that verify whether the agent completed the task the right way — catching corners cut, not just checking outputs
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback — review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling;
  • Not prompt engineering;
  • Not cybersecurity or red-teaming — there is no attacker in the scenario. Cybersecurity experience is a nice-to-have but not a requirement. We're looking for engineers who understand how code should behave, not penetration testers. Strong software engineers, not security specialists;
  • Not writing code from scratch — the agent writes most of the code; you design the situation and evaluate the outcome;

What we look for

  • 4–5+ years in software development;
  • Core stack: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Strong test design skills — functional and integration tests that separate safe from unsafe completion, not just correct from incorrect;
  • Hands-on experience with coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex, or similar);
  • Familiarity with GitHub PRs and CI workflows as a user;
  • Stack breadth is welcome, not a filter. Tasks simulate real repositories with databases, CI pipelines, and deploy scripts, so wider backend and infrastructure exposure is genuinely useful — but you don't need to be an expert in every layer;
  • English proficiency — B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. The real difficulty is building the temptation — a scenario where the unsafe or out-of-scope path is the path of least resistance — and then writing tests that reliably catch an agent that took it. Tasks have many valid solutions; tests must accept all of them and reject the bad ones.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 20-25 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better.

The Product Marketing team is looking for a Lead Product Marketer to own go-to-market strategy and positioning for HubSpot’s rapidly expanding portfolio of developer and agent infrastructure products. This role will shape how developers, AI-assisted builders, partners, and customers understand and adopt products including the Developer Platform, APIs, MCP, CLI, AI coding tools, etc. You’ll operate at the center of one of HubSpot’s most strategic growth areas, helping define HubSpot’s position as the platform of choice for developers and agents.

This is a highly cross-functional role that partners closely with Product, Developer Relations, Engineering, Brand, Communications, Legal, Marketing, and executive leadership to deliver launches, shape narratives, and drive adoption. The ideal candidate combines technical fluency, strategic storytelling, and strong operational ownership to navigate a fast-moving and technically complex product landscape.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead go-to-market strategy, positioning, naming, messaging, and release marketing for HubSpot’s developer products.
  • Orchestrate launches for technical products including APIs, AI coding tools, MCP, CLI, Developer Platform, etc.
  • Define and evolve HubSpot’s emerging builder persona across traditional developers and AI-assisted builders using modern coding platforms and tools.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, Engineering, and executive stakeholders to align messaging, launch readiness, and product narratives.
  • Build cohesive external narratives that translate technically complex capabilities into clear value for developers, partners, customers, and leadership audiences.
  • Identify and experiment with new routes to market that drive awareness, engagement, and adoption among technical and non-technical builders.
  • Develop launch assets, enablement materials, newsletters, campaign messaging, FAQs, release communications, and technical marketing content to reach new and existing users.
  • Drive cross-functional coordination across a broad stakeholder network while proactively identifying dependencies and mitigating launch risks.
  • Analyze market trends, competitive positioning, customer feedback, and usage data to refine go-to-market strategy and improve adoption outcomes.
  • Support HubSpot builder-focused events and launch moments, including quarterly builder activations and technical product showcases.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or developer-focused go-to-market roles within a SaaS or product-led growth company.
  • Demonstrated success owning and executing end-to-end launches for technical or developer-facing products.
  • Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, APIs, webhooks, CLI, integrations, and technical platform concepts.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, and narratives for emerging or evolving product categories.
  • Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Data-driven approach to measuring adoption, engagement, and launch effectiveness.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and workflows to improve efficiency, accelerate execution, and scale marketing operations.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience marketing AI infrastructure, developer platforms, APIs, or automation products.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted coding workflows and builder platforms.
  • Experience partnering closely with Developer Relations or technical community teams.
  • Experience supporting technical events, developer communities, or ecosystem marketing programs.

$144,000—$216,000 USD

The Program Analyst, Incentive Operations supports the execution of Sophos global incentive programs through data management, system administration, and operational support. This role is critical to maintaining data accuracy, supporting internal and partner inquiries, and ensuring smooth execution across SPIFFs, rebates, and BDF programs.

The role will also support incentive platform management, including program setup, data maintenance, and troubleshooting in partnership with vendors. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong Excel capabilities, experience with Salesforce and Power BI, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

The accuracy of the work performed in this role directly impacts partner attainment, incentive payments, executive reporting, and partner communications.

Impact of the Role

  • Maintains rigorous data validation and quality control processes to minimize operational risk and ensure confidence in program reporting.

Sonepar Management Group (SMG) supports our Sonepar brands (i.e. operating companies) in the US through a shared services model. These services include, but are not limited to: human resources, finance, digital enterprise, supply chain, vendor relations, marketing, legal, and communications. The SMG teams enable our brands to do business in their local regions while taking advantage of the scale and collective resources of a global enterprise.

SMG fosters an inclusive and supportive culture. We offer leadership and development programs to help you reach your career goals. Our associates share in our collective achievements, and we firmly believe that Sonepar is “Powered by Difference.” By driving technology and innovation, enabling paths to success, and caring about our people and their families, we have built a workplace where you can build a fulfilling career.

Sonepar is seeking a Construction Project Manager to support construction projects across our nationwide portfolio of distribution centers, warehouses, branch locations, and office facilities.
This is not a traditional project management role. We are seeking a construction professional who can serve as Sonepar's internal construction expert and owner's representative for tenant improvements, facility renovations, relocations, and build-to-suit projects. Success in this role requires strong commercial or industrial construction knowledge, including the ability to review drawings, collaborate with architects and contractors, identify issues before construction begins, and guide projects from planning through completion.
**National scope with approximately 30-40% travel.
**Excellent opportunity for professionals with commercial, industrial, distribution center, warehouse, or tenant improvement construction experience.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with business leaders, landlords, architects, engineers, and contractors to plan and execute facility projects across the United States.
  • Manage construction projects including tenant improvements, facility upgrades, relocations, reconfigurations, and build-to-suit developments.
  • Review blueprints, drawings, specifications, and facility layouts to identify potential issues before construction begins.
  • Monitor project schedules, budgets, vendor performance, and overall project execution.
  • Obtain contractor proposals, evaluate bids, and support contract administration activities.
  • Serve as an owner's representative, ensuring operational requirements are incorporated into project designs and construction plans.
  • Provide regular project updates and communicate risks, opportunities, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Develop and improve internal processes related to facility documentation, move-in inspections, property condition assessments, and lease documentation.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Experience managing commercial or industrial construction projects.
  • Strong understanding of construction processes, permitting, building requirements, and project execution.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, and specifications.
  • Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, consultants, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong project budgeting, scheduling, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Commercial real estate or tenant improvement construction experience.
  • Experience serving as an Owner's Representative, Construction Manager, Commercial Construction PM, or similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Procore, Bluebeam, MS Project, or similar construction and project management tools.
  • Professional certifications such as CCM, CAC, or CPC are a plus.

What We Offer You

We offer great family-friendly benefits to full-time associates:

  • Dental & vision
  • Paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) retirement savings with company match
  • Professional and personal development programs

  • Employer-paid short- and long-term disability
  • Employer-paid life insurance for spouse and dependents
  • Robust wellness program
  • Gym reimbursement

We’re proud to be a military-friendly company, and our many employee resource groups (ERGs) help you make connections and feel supported.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About The Firm

We work with accounting firm clients across the United States, many of whom are actively looking to hire for these roles. Our approach stands apart from much of today’s private equity–driven accounting landscape. We believe the profession has become too focused on profits at the expense of people and culture.

Instead, we partner with firms that value technical excellence, fairness, and respect for their professionals. Clear expectations, sustainable workloads, and a culture of integrity define how these firms operate—and how, together, we aim to lead the next generation of accounting firms.

About the Role
The Tax Manager I and II are responsible for delivering high-quality, technically sound tax work across a diverse client base. This position is ideal for professionals who value precision, consistency, and meaningful work in a firm that prioritizes fairness and clarity over long hours and bureaucracy.

The Tax Manager II will manage easy-complexity engagements including review, signing, and client relationship management, while supporting more senior team members on medium-complexity projects. The Tax Manager II will manage easy and medium-complexity engagements including review, signing, and client relationship management, while supporting more senior team members on hard-complexity projects.It’s a role built for tax professionals who take pride in technical excellence and want to grow within a healthy, well-run practice.

We have strong systems, software, and support staff in place, so administrative and preparatory tasks are not part of this role. We value team players who can help when needed, but are committed to keeping your time focused on work that matches your level and skill set.

Responsibilities

  • Handle the review, signing, and client relationship management for engagements of appropriate complexity, while supporting more senior team members on more complex projects.

  • Provide limited client relationship management tied to assigned engagements, balancing technical accuracy with clear and effective communication.

  • Act as a technical resource for junior staff on foundational tax concepts while maintaining an active workload of assigned returns.

  • Contribute to firm integration and process-improvement initiatives as new practices are onboarded.

  • Familiarity with a wide range of return types, with primary exposure to 1040, 1120, 1120S, and 1065.

  • Periodic involvement with 1041, 990s, financial statements, and miscellaneous filings such as 1031 exchanges and FBAR as needed.


Requirements

  • CPA or EA designation preferred.

  • 4-15 years of public accounting experience with strong technical tax skills.

  • Proficiency in individual, partnership, and S corporation tax compliance.

  • High attention to detail and ability to manage a range of return complexities.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, especially in a remote environment.


Benefits

  • Compensation Range: $90k-$150k

raw.description:
Customer Service, Executive Assistant & Contracts Administrator

Commercial and Residential Plumbing

Location: Remote / Work from Home
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Commercial and Residential Plumbing
Reporting To: Director / Operations Manager

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Customer Service, Executive Assistant and Contracts Administrator to provide end-to-end administrative and operational support to a busy commercial and residential plumbing business.

This is a hands-on role covering customer enquiries, job coordination, executive assistance, contracts administration, compliance documentation and the lodgement of plumbing certificates.

The successful candidate must be highly organised, confident communicating with Australian customers, builders, subcontractors, suppliers, councils and certifiers, and capable of managing multiple jobs and deadlines without constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service and Job Coordination

  • Answer incoming calls, emails and online enquiries.
  • Provide professional customer service to homeowners, builders, strata managers, developers and commercial clients.
  • Gather job details, site information, plans, photographs and access instructions.
  • Schedule plumbing inspections, service calls and project work.
  • Allocate jobs to plumbers, subcontractors and technicians.
  • Coordinate appointments between clients, site supervisors and field staff.
  • Confirm bookings and provide customers with arrival updates.
  • Monitor jobs from initial enquiry through to completion.
  • Follow up outstanding quotations and service enquiries.
  • Handle customer concerns and escalate technical or urgent matters.
  • Maintain accurate notes and customer records within the job-management system.

Executive Assistant Support

  • Provide direct administrative support to the Director and management team.
  • Manage calendars, meetings, appointments and reminders.
  • Prioritise emails, calls, documents and follow-up actions.
  • Prepare correspondence, reports, meeting notes and internal documentation.
  • Maintain action lists and follow up staff, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Coordinate meetings with clients, builders, developers and project stakeholders.
  • Assist with travel, purchasing and general business administration.
  • Protect confidential commercial, employee and customer information.
  • Help management maintain visibility across active jobs and outstanding issues.

Contracts Administration

  • Assist with the administration of residential and commercial plumbing contracts.
  • Review contracts, scopes of work, purchase orders and subcontractor agreements.
  • Maintain contract registers and project documentation.
  • Track contract dates, milestones, deliverables and completion requirements.
  • Prepare and issue progress claims, variations and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor approved variations and outstanding client approvals.
  • Match completed work against quotations, purchase orders and contracts.
  • Coordinate site instructions, requests for information and document revisions.
  • Maintain records of approvals, correspondence and contractual notices.
  • Assist with practical completion, defects and project close-out documentation.
  • Escalate contract risks, delays, disputes and scope changes to management.

Plumbing Certificates and Compliance Lodgements

  • Prepare, lodge and track required plumbing certificates and compliance documents.
  • Coordinate with plumbers to obtain licence details, test results, photographs and completion information.
  • Lodge documents through relevant council, certifier, water authority and government portals.
  • Assist with Certificates of Compliance and other required plumbing documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records of lodgement dates, reference numbers and approvals.
  • Follow up rejected, incomplete or outstanding submissions.
  • Monitor certification and inspection deadlines.
  • Book required inspections with councils, certifiers or relevant authorities.
  • Ensure documentation is correctly completed before submission.
  • Maintain organised electronic folders for certificates, inspections, permits and approvals.
  • Support project handover by compiling final compliance documentation.

Quotations and Sales Administration

  • Prepare quotations using information supplied by plumbers, estimators and management.
  • Format and issue professional residential and commercial proposals.
  • Follow up outstanding quotations and record customer outcomes.
  • Maintain quote registers and sales-pipeline information.
  • Convert approved quotations into jobs or work orders.
  • Confirm client details, site contacts, scope and purchase-order requirements.
  • Assist with tender documents and subcontractor submissions.
  • Support account managers and management with customer follow-up.
  • Identify repeat-service and maintenance opportunities.

Invoicing and Accounts Support

  • Prepare invoices, deposits and progress claims.
  • Ensure purchase-order numbers and supporting documents are included.
  • Match supplier invoices and subcontractor charges to the correct jobs.
  • Follow up overdue customer accounts professionally.
  • Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable administration.
  • Track job costs, deposits, outstanding balances and retention amounts.
  • Liaise with the bookkeeper regarding invoice and payment queries.
  • Maintain accurate records for each project and service job.

Field Team Administration

  • Maintain plumbers' schedules and daily job allocations.
  • Ensure field staff receive job details, plans, contacts and access instructions.
  • Follow up job completion notes, timesheets, photographs and materials used.
  • Check that field documentation is complete before jobs are closed or invoiced.
  • Coordinate materials, equipment and supplier deliveries.
  • Track licences, insurances, inductions and subcontractor documentation.
  • Maintain employee, vehicle, equipment and training registers.
  • Assist with onboarding new employees and subcontractors.

Document and System Management

  • Maintain accurate digital customer and project files.
  • Upload plans, contracts, purchase orders, variations, certificates and correspondence.
  • Apply consistent document naming and version-control procedures.
  • Keep customer, supplier and subcontractor records current.
  • Maintain registers for contracts, quotes, certificates, variations and inspections.
  • Produce weekly reports covering active jobs, outstanding documentation and overdue actions.
  • Improve administrative processes and create practical templates and checklists.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Previous Australian experience in plumbing, construction, building services or a trade-services business.
  • Strong customer-service and administration experience.
  • Experience coordinating residential and commercial jobs.
  • Experience preparing and lodging certificates, permits or compliance documents.
  • Understanding of contracts, purchase orders, variations and progress claims.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Confident telephone manner when dealing with Australian customers.
  • Strong attention to detail and document-management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines and urgent service requests.
  • Ability to work independently and follow matters through to completion.
  • Strong Microsoft Office and Google Workspace skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and suitable remote-working environment.

Highly Regarded Experience

  • Experience working directly for an Australian plumbing company.
  • Knowledge of commercial construction and residential plumbing workflows.
  • Experience dealing with councils, private certifiers and water authorities.
  • Familiarity with Australian plumbing certificates and compliance processes.
  • Experience with tendering, contracts and project administration.
  • Understanding of progress claims, retentions and contract variations.
  • Experience supporting a business owner, director or operations manager.
  • Familiarity with construction plans, hydraulic drawings and scopes of work.
  • Experience coordinating plumbers, subcontractors and site supervisors.

Preferred Software Experience

Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

  • Simpro
  • AroFlo
  • ServiceM8
  • Fergus
  • Ascora
  • Xero
  • MYOB
  • Procore
  • Buildxact
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Outlook
  • Google Workspace
  • Council, certifier and authority lodgement portals

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against:

  • Response time to customer enquiries.
  • Accuracy of bookings and job information.
  • Percentage of jobs with complete documentation.
  • On-time lodgement of plumbing certificates and compliance documents.
  • Quote follow-up and conversion rates.
  • Accuracy of contracts, variations and progress claims.
  • Reduction in missed appointments and administrative errors.
  • Timely invoicing after job completion.
  • Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
  • Accuracy of project registers and management reporting.
  • Completion of executive follow-up actions by deadline.

Ideal Candidate

You are a highly organised and proactive administrator who understands how a busy plumbing or construction business operates.

You can speak confidently with customers, coordinate field teams, manage contracts, prepare compliance documentation and follow up outstanding actions without waiting to be reminded.

You take ownership of each task from initial enquiry through to job completion, certification, invoicing and final close-out.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV outlining:

  • Your Australian plumbing, construction or trade-services experience.
  • Your customer-service and job-coordination experience.
  • Your executive-assistant experience.
  • Your contracts-administration experience.
  • The certificates, permits or compliance documents you have lodged.
  • The councils, certifiers or authorities you have dealt with.
  • The job-management and accounting systems you have used.
  • Examples of residential and commercial projects you have supported.

Applicants with direct Australian plumbing-industry experience will be strongly preferred.

raw.description:
Licensed Practical or Registered Nurse (RN) — Remote Care Management

Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) · Chronic Care Management (CCM) · Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM)

Employer: Claris Healthcare Inc.

Location: Remote (U.S.) — multistate license through the NLC required

Job types: Full-time, Part-time · 1099 Independent Contractor

Pay: Starting at $40.00 per hour USD (see Compensation) + $750 bonus

About Claris

Most of us were drawn to health care by a simple idea: a meaningful job helping others live healthier, happier, and longer lives. At Claris Healthcare, you will work one-on-one with patients to spot health issues early and build proactive, personalized solutions around each patient’s own preferences and goals. You will play a central role in helping patients embrace preventive health and recognize that consistent self-care is the key to a healthier life.

About the Role

This is a rewarding role for an experienced LPN/RN who loves building relationships with patients and coaching them toward better health. You will support the delivery of three remote care-management services for our primary care and Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) partners: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), and Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM). You will monitor patient-generated health data, maintain comprehensive care plans, coordinate care, document communication, collaborate with providers and ultimately help patients make sustainable changes to improve their health.

Much of your day will be spent directly interfacing with patients. The right candidate brings genuine empathy and the skill to ask open-ended, patient-centered questions that surface what truly matters to each person, so you can build a care plan with meaningful outcomes.

Using an open, non-judgmental, motivational approach, you will meet people where they are, build rapport over time, and keep the door open even when someone is not ready to change today.

The remainder of your time is spent on accurate documentation. Each program has specific requirements — RPM monitoring and management time, CCM care-plan and time-tracking rules, and APCM’s bundled service elements — and your records are critical in substantiating the care delivered and each clinic’s billing. You will receive training on documentation standards, the Claris Companion platform, and partner EHRs. Strong attention to detail and comfort with healthcare software are essential.

What You’ll Do

  • Log into the Claris Companion platform daily to monitor RPM data and clinical alerts, triage out-of-range readings, and reach out promptly to patients who need support.
  • Help patients stay engaged with their monitoring so they meet program requirements and, more importantly, benefit from the care.
  • Deliver CCM and APCM services: develop and maintain patient-centered, comprehensive care plans; conduct regular check-ins; perform medication reconciliation; and coordinate care transitions and community or social-service referrals.
  • Build trusting, motivational relationships with patients using open-ended, patient-centered conversation, addressing sensitive topics and SDOH with empathy.
  • Document every encounter accurately and log service start and end times to meet each program’s documentation and billing requirements; enter billing and diagnosis codes for the services you provide.
  • Maintain audit-ready records and follow HIPAA and program-compliance standards at all times.
  • Work closely with the supervising practitioner and clinic team, escalating patients who need provider attention in a timely manner.
  • Support continuity of care and the programs’ patient-access expectations as scheduled.
  • Schedule follow-up contacts when all required services cannot be completed in a single session.
  • Ask questions when anything is unclear, and confirm rather than assume.
  • Be your patients’ biggest cheerleader — celebrate small wins and milestones!

Requirements

Qualifications — Required

  • Active, unencumbered RN or LPN license with multistate privilege through the Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC).
  • Bilingual (Spanish)
  • Willingness and ability to obtain additional individual state licenses as the patient population requires — a nurse must be licensed in the state where the patient is located. A California and/or District of Columbia license is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of LPN?RN experience; direct experience providing remote care (RPM, CCM, and/or APCM is required)
  • Working knowledge of EHRs and patient-monitoring / care-management software, with strong computer and typing skills. Experience with eClinical Works, Athena and Epic EHRs is considered an asset.
  • Familiarity with Medicare care-management programs and their documentation and billing requirements — or the ability to learn them quickly.
  • Comfortable working independently under the general supervision of the billing practitioner.
  • Exceptional listening skills and empathy, with the ability to ask patient-centered, open-ended questions and see issues from the patient’s perspective.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong time management across a patient panel.
  • Professional, warm, and personable in every patient interaction.

Qualifications — A Plus

  • Care or case management certification (e.g., CCM — Certified Case Manager).
  • Disease-specific certification (e.g., CDCES — Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist).
  • Experience serving underserved, community-health, or FQHC patient populations and addressing SDOH.
  • Training or experience in motivational interviewing.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with a disability to perform these essential functions:

  • Sitting for up to four hours at a time.
  • Typing and/or computer work up to eight hours per day.
  • Interacting with patients with a high level of energy for up to eight hours per day.

Benefits

Compensation & Work Arrangement

  • Full-time 1099 position for independent contractors starting at $40.00 USD/hour, you determine your own hours, coordinating your availability with your patients’ needs.
  • Possibility to convert to a Full-time Permanent Employee position in the future.
  • Remote work anywhere in the U.S., subject to holding the appropriate state license(s).
  • Job types: Full-time, Part-time.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

About the company

Timely and SalonBiz serve over 30,000 customers in 100 countries and are on a mission to build the leading platform for beauty professionals. Together we make up EverWell, an EverCommerce vertical. Between us, we offer SaaS solutions to customers of varying sizes and stages, serving different customer profiles within the beauty industry. You'll help beauty professionals get the most from SalonBiz by driving customer adoption, retention, and growth, while coaching the team to deliver exceptional customer outcomes across the entire customer lifecycle. Working closely with the Manager of Customer Success and Customer Care, you'll also support strategic initiatives and continuously improve Customer Success operations.

What you'll do.

  • Build strong relationships with your own portfolio of customers, helping them get the most out of SalonBiz and achieve their business goals.

  • Spot challenges early and work with your team to keep customers engaged, supported and set up for success.

  • Share ideas and improve the way we work, helping shape processes that make life easier for both customers and the team.

  • Create a positive team environment where collaboration, accountability and continuous learning are part of everyday work.

What you'll bring.

  • A track recordofenabling and empoweringteams to take ownership, make decisions and consistently deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

  • Experience building a culture of accountability through coaching, clearexpectationsand continuous development.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to balance customer success,retentionand revenue growth.

  • Confidence using customer health metrics and performance data to drive priorities and improve outcomes.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across all levels.

  • A proactive, customer-first mindset with a passion for building engaged, high-performing teams.

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

CIOs are navigating a period of unprecedented complexity in technology investment decisions. The growth of cloud, AI, consumption-based technology services, and the shift from project-based funding to ongoing product and platform investments have fundamentally changed how technology costs are incurred, governed and measured. As technology finance evolves from a cost management discipline to a strategic enabler of technology investment decisions and business value, Gartner is seeking a leader who can help shape the future agenda for CIOs and their teams across technology budgeting, spend transparency, cost optimization, cloud and AI economics, and value-focused governance.

Important: This is not a corporate FP&A position. The role focuses on advising CIOs on IT Financial Management (ITFM), including technology budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, cloud and AI economics, and technology value realization. Candidates should bring experience supporting CIO organizations and applying ITFM, TBM, or FinOps practices to improve decision-making and business outcomes. General FP&A backgrounds without technology-specific finance experience will not be considered.

Your experience will ideally come from working closely with CIOs, including:

  • Experience leading or advising IT Financial Management disciplines, including technology budgeting, cost transparency, benchmarking, service costing, strategic cost management, and cloud/AI spend governance.
  • Understanding of the ITFM, TBM and FinOps technology landscape, including experience evaluating relevant vendors and solutions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the economic and governance implications of cloud and AI, including unit economics, consumption-based pricing, FinOps practices, and the impact of vendor pricing changes on CIO investment decisions and value realization.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions
  • Serve as a recognized authority on Technology Cost and Value Management, helping CIOs establish effective approaches to technology budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, and value realization across the enterprise.
  • Develop and communicate strong positions on emerging and leading practices in IT Financial Management, cloud and AI economics, and technology investment optimization that enable better business outcomes.

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in technology finance, IT Financial Management (ITFM), Technology Business Management (TBM), FinOps, technology strategy, or related leadership roles
  • Experience supporting CIOs, technology leaders, or IT organizations in budgeting, investment governance, cost transparency, and technology value management
  • Demonstrated expertise in modern technology cost structures, including infrastructure, applications, platforms, cloud, AI, and product-based delivery models
  • Experience applying ITFM, TBM, FinOps, or related practices to improve technology investment decision-making and business outcomes

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.
