raw.description:
The Kardex Group is one of the world's leading manufacturers of dynamic storage, retrieval and distribution systems. Our more than 3,000 employees worldwide develop and manufacture logistics solutions that are used in many different sectors such as industrial manufacturing, retail and administration.

Kardex AutoStore is a global leader in high-speed Automatic Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS)—boosting storage capacity by up to four times. Trusted worldwide, our cutting-edge technology strengthens Kardex’s portfolio of advanced intralogistics solutions, helping businesses achieve smarter, faster, and more efficient order fulfillment.

A Senior Project Manager leads complex, high‑value implementation projects from sales handover through final acceptance, owning scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and customer satisfaction. This role serves as the strategic partner for customers and internal teams, driving solution alignment, commercial performance, and operational excellence. The Senior PM manages multi‑stakeholder projects, negotiates change orders, ensures strong financial outcomes, and provides leadership across engineering, software, supply chain, and service. They also mentor project managers, improve processes and tools, and contribute to organizational growth in a fast‑paced, startup‑like environment.

Your tasks

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading large, complex implementation projects from sales handover through final acceptance. This role manages all aspects of project delivery, including scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and customer satisfaction. It requires coordination across engineering, software, supply chain, installation partners, and service teams to ensure successful execution and alignment with customer requirements.

The Senior Project Manager provides strategic input during the sales phase, supports solution development, and ensures structured transitions between sales, realization, and service. Responsibilities include financial oversight, forecasting, margin protection, change order negotiation, and proactive risk management. The role also contributes to organizational development by mentoring project managers, improving project tools and processes, and supporting governance standards.

Your profile

Advanced project leadership — Demonstrated ability to lead multi‑phase automation or logistics projects with complex technical, operational, and commercial requirements.

  • Cross‑functional coordination — Proven success aligning engineering, software, supply chain, installation partners, and service teams toward unified project outcomes.
  • Strategic communication — Ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders, translate technical concepts into business impacts, and manage expectations across diverse audiences.
  • Commercial and financial acumen — Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, margin protection, contract terms, and change‑order negotiation.
  • Risk and governance discipline — Strong capability in identifying risks early, implementing mitigation plans, and maintaining structured project governance.
  • Process improvement mindset — Ability to evaluate existing tools, templates, and workflows and contribute to continuous improvement across the project organization.
  • Mentorship and team development — Experience guiding project managers or junior team members, supporting skill development, and reinforcing best practices.
  • Technical literacy — Comfortable working with automation systems, warehouse technologies, IT integrations, and design tools such as AutoCAD and project management platforms.
  • Customer‑centric approach — Ability to understand customer operations, anticipate needs, and maintain strong long‑term relationships.
  • Adaptability in growth environments — Comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, evolving organization with shifting priorities and emerging processes.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in intralogistics and automation.
  • A collaborative engineering environment with strong technical expertise.
  • Professional development within a fast‑growing AutoStore business.
  • Exposure to cutting‑edge ASRS technology and innovative installation methods

raw.description:
The Utilization Management Nurse Reviewer plays a crucial role in healthcare systems by ensuring that medical services are used efficiently and appropriately. They review medical records, treatment plans, and patient information to determine the necessity and appropriateness of medical procedures, tests, and treatments.

Utilization Management Nurse Reviewers collaborate with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and patients to optimize healthcare delivery, control costs, and maintain quality care. Their responsibilities include assessing medical necessity, coordinating care, conducting utilization reviews, providing recommendations for care plans, and ensuring adherence to regulations and guidelines. This role requires strong clinical knowledge, critical thinking skills, communication abilities, and the ability to make informed decisions regarding patient care pathways.

Our PRN Nursing Program is designed for flexible, as-needed staffing to support our team during peak times, weekends, and holidays.

  • PRN nurses will be required to work at least one weekend per month, one major holiday, and one minor holiday per year.
  • A minimum number of shifts per month will be mandated to ensure that PRN nurses maintain their QA skills and familiarity with processes.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct assessments of medical services to validate their appropriateness using established criteria and guidelines, ensuring the medical necessity of treatments (e.g., CMS, Milliman Care Guidelines, InterQual, or health plan specific guidelines/criteria).
  • Examine and evaluate patient records to verify the quality of patient care and the necessity of provided services.
  • Offer clinical expertise and serve as a clinical reference for non-clinical staff members.
  • Input and manage essential clinical details within various medical management platforms.
  • Keep up-to-date with regulatory prerequisites (such as URAC) and state standards for utilization review.
  • Apply clinical reasoning to determine the suitable evidence-based guidelines.
  • Foster efficient and high-quality patient care by effectively communicating with management teams, physicians, and the Medical Director.

Requirements

  • Proficient in both written and spoken communication.
  • Capable of maintaining professional communication with physicians and clients.
  • Skilled at handling multiple tasks and adjusting swiftly in a dynamic office setting.
  • Possesses a keen organizational sense and pays close attention to details.
  • Adept at resolving intricate and multifaceted problems.
  • Experienced with Microsoft tools such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Background in medical or clinical practice through education, training, or professional engagement.
  • Holds an unrestricted LVN/RN license from an accredited vocational nursing program (for LVNs) or a nursing degree from an accredited college (for RNs).

Additional Duties

  • May provide oversight to the work of the team members.
  • Continuously improves processes that help to facilitate better turnaround time, peer to peer success rates and lessens returned reports by clients for clarification purposes, ultimately resulting in higher client satisfaction.
  • Responsible for the final approval on cases for release to the client.
  • Will act as a liaison and coordinate quality issue reports along with all new reviewer reports with the VP of Clinical Operations.

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

Licensed Practical/Vocational Nurse with an active and unrestricted license to practice.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

2 yrs minimum clinical nursing experience is required.

One year of previous experience in Utilization Management is required.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Demonstrate strong abilities in both spoken and written communication, along with effective interpersonal skills. Possess a proficient understanding of computer operations, particularly the Internet, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Access, Microsoft Excel, and Windows. Show the capability to acquire new skills and competencies to address the evolving requirements of systems, software, and hardware.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

Requirements

Beginning compensation will depend on several factors including the candidate's experience, education, and specific skills. In addition to the base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plans, and performance bonuses.

Our Commitment:

We are committed to providing fair and competitive compensation that reflects each employee's contributions and performance. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all employees.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a LMS Coordinator to manage the day-to-day operations of our Learning Management System (LMS) and produce multimedia content for our Learning & Development team. In this role, you will execute routine LMS administration tasks, transform raw video and webinar recordings into polished educational content following established templates, and contribute to rapid-authoring instructional design projects under the guidance of senior L&D team members. This is a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

  • LMS Administration
    • Manage the day-to-day execution of the Learning Management System (LMS), including course uploads, managing user enrollment rules, automating notifications, and configuring system settings.
    • Serve as first-line technical support for LMS users, resolving routine access and navigation issues and escalating complex technical problems to a senior team member.
    • Run and distribute standard system usage, compliance, and completion reports using existing dashboard templates.
  • Video Post-Production & Digital Asset Management
    • Edit raw video assets, recording sessions, and live webinars into polished educational products within learning modules.
    • Take long-form video training (e.g., presentations, lectures, or system walkthroughs)and skillfully repurpose them into bite-sized, short-form videos.
    • Drive digital inclusivity by executing video accessibility workflows, including generating and sync-matching closed-captioning files.
    • Organize and maintain a centralized media library in a cloud-based environment (e.g., Google Drive) to maintain seamless version control over raw footage, graphical components, brand assets, and templates.
  • Rapid Instructional Design & Quality Assurance
    • Complete QA testing checklists on newly built learning modules under the guidance of a senior team member, flagging tracking, assessment, or navigation issues for review.
    • Partner with the Learning & Development team and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to update and maintain existing rapid-authoring e-learning modules using established templates, focusing on content clarity, flow, and graphic layout.
    • Draft first-pass course summaries and knowledge-check questions for review and approval by a senior team member.
    • Track timelines and asset checklists for assigned video production and LMS projects, flagging risks to delivery milestones for the team lead.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional/Educational Technology, Information Systems, Digital Media/Communications, or a related technical discipline—or equivalent practical and technical field experience.
  • 0–1 years of hands-on experience with corporate or institutional LMS platforms (internship, coursework, or project-based exposure accepted; healthcare or clinical training environment experience a plus; experience with Absorb LMS is a plus).
  • Proficiency with basic video editing (e.g., TechSmith Camtasia, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or equivalent software).
  • Exposure to rapid e-learning authoring tools (such as Articulate Rise) with an understanding of basic adult learning concepts.
  • A strong grasp of visual design basics (spacing, hierarchy, formatting) paired with accessibility principles (ADA compliance, closed captioning).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills within and across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Ability to be flexible and work well both independently and as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team in a fast-paced, mission driven environment.
  • Interest and/or background in behavioral health is a plus.
  • Flexibility and adaptability are key in our dynamic startup environment; we're looking for candidates who embrace change, thrive in ambiguity, and can pivot seamlessly to contribute to an ever-evolving set of tasks and team.

The expected annual salary for this role is between $65,000-$72,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, etc.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly () to verify its authenticity.

Job Title:Clinical DRG Denial Specialist

Location: Remote

Schedule: Per Diem

SUMMARY:
The Clinical DRG Denials Specialist applies clinical knowledge, coding principles, payer policy interpretation, and documentation review to support appropriate reimbursement and regulatory compliance and works to protect organizational reimbursement by ensuring the accurate review, appeal, and resolution of DRG-related payer denials. Additionally, the position proactively works to identify documentation and coding risks before claim submission to reduce avoidable denials and strengthen revenue integrity. Through analysis of denial trends and appeal outcomes, the role helps improve processes and support denial prevention strategies across the revenue cycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Ensures accurate and timely resolution of DRG-related payer denials and audit activity in order to protect reimbursement and minimize avoidable revenue loss.
• Produces well-supported and compliant appeal outcomes by applying clinical, coding, and payer policy knowledge to disputed DRG determinations.
• Maintains adherence to contractual, regulatory, and documentation requirements across denial, appeal, and pre-bill review activities to support compliance and payment integrity.
• Strengthens revenue integrity by identifying and addressing documentation, coding, and medical necessity risks before claim submission.
• Improves denial prevention performance through analysis of payer trends, denial patterns, and appeal outcomes, leading to responsive strategies and process enhancements.
• Ensures denial-related information, requirements, and case status are consistently maintained to support accurate tracking, reconciliation, and operational visibility.
• Promotes effective, standardized denial and appeal practices that support efficient workflows and consistent organizational response to payer challenges.
• Applies specialized clinical and coding expertise to support accurate DRG assignment, documentation integrity, and sustainable reimbursement outcomes across the revenue cycle.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Degree in Nursing

  • NYS Registered Nurse Licensure

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Knowledge of Epic preferred

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications preferred

  • Practical experience with computerized encoding and grouping software preferred

  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) or Certified Coding Specialist certification (CCS) preferred.

  • BSN preferred.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

CI&T is seeking a senior Data MDM Architect to join an embedded engagement with a leading U.S.-based client operating at the intersection of ESG advisory and carbon credit trading. The client manages complex, high-volume data across multiple integrated platforms to support both enterprise sustainability consulting and financial trading operations. As data volumes, integration complexity, and regulatory expectations grow, the need for a unified, authoritative data architecture has become a strategic priority — making this role critical to the client's next phase of growth.

In this role, you will act as a strategic advisor and hands-on architect, designing and governing the "golden source of truth" for counterparties, products, and contacts across a multi-platform ecosystem. This is not a purely strategic position — you will be expected to engage directly with US-based technical leadership, conduct architectural discovery, produce deliverables, and make consequential decisions independently. You will cover the full data lifecycle: ingestion, cleansing, MDM, integration patterns, governance, and reporting — ensuring every layer of the architecture is correct, scalable, and resilient from day one.

Responsibilities:

  • Architectural Review & Validation: Assess and validate the current multi-platform data architecture and MDM strategy, identifying technical debt, integration gaps, and risks to data integrity across Salesforce, NetSuite, and other integrated systems.

  • MDM Strategy Design: Define and deliver the master data management architecture, establishing the "golden source of truth" for core entities — counterparties, products, contacts, and financial instruments — across all five core platforms.

  • Data Governance Framework: Develop and implement enterprise-grade data governance policies covering data ownership, lineage, access controls, and stewardship to ensure consistent data integrity across the ecosystem.

  • Entity Mapping & STP Alignment: Lead the mapping of complex counterparty and product data entities to enable seamless straight-through processing (STP) across trading and ERP workflows.

  • Integration Pattern Design: Architect resilient, scalable integration patterns for the Azure-based middleware layer to handle master data synchronization without duplication or data drift across connected platforms.

  • Technical Discovery Partnership: Collaborate closely with US-based technical leads during the Discovery phase to surface architectural risks, validate current data flows, and define the roadmap for remediation.

  • MDM Solution Advisory: Evaluate and recommend "out-of-the-box" vs. "custom-built" MDM approaches through structured SWOT analysis, balancing cost, scalability, and time-to-value.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex architectural decisions into clear, actionable guidance for both technical teams and executive stakeholders (CTO, CPTO), driving alignment across business and engineering.

  • Long-Term Data Roadmap: Develop a strategic roadmap for data lineage, access controls, and the evolution toward modern Data Fabric solutions — including a forward-looking plan for unstructured data and AI-augmented architectures.

Requirements:

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 or above), with demonstrated ability to lead strategic discussions and sell ideas to US-based executive and technical leadership

  • Solid experience in Data Architecture and MDM strategy, with a track record of delivering full end-to-end data architectures in enterprise environments

  • Proven experience designing data governance frameworks in complex, regulated environments such as financial services, commodity trading, or ESG/energy markets

  • Demonstrated ability to work in an embedded, autonomous capacity — proactively engaging stakeholders, driving architectural decisions, and delivering results without requiring a dedicated team

  • Experience with Azure-based data architectures and middleware integration patterns (e.g., Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, or equivalent)

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge client assumptions constructively and advocate for sound architectural choices at the executive level

Nice to Have:

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with NetSuite (ERP) and Salesforce (CRM) data structures, integration patterns, and data modeling — ability to operate independently in both platforms from day one

  • Familiarity with carbon markets, ESG data structures, or financial trading platforms

  • Experience with modern Data Fabric or Data Mesh architectural patterns

  • Knowledge of RAG-based AI strategies applied to enterprise data environments

  • Exposure to contract lifecycle management or legal data management systems

  • Relevant certifications in data management, cloud architecture, or enterprise integration (e.g., DAMA CDMP, Azure Solutions Architect)

  • Experience operating across LATAM or North American cross-cultural technical teams

In this role, you will manage the complete billing cycle: claim submission, payment posting, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, and reporting. You will work directly with practice leadership and administrative teams to ensure claims are clean, payments are collected, and outstanding balances are resolved in a timely manner. Depending on the client, you may also provide light support to front desk and administrative functions as a secondary responsibility.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Claims Submission & Billing Operations

  • Process and submit insurance claims accurately and in a timely manner via EMR and clearinghouse systems
  • Manage the full billing cycle including claim creation, submission, tracking, and follow-up
  • Handle primary and secondary insurance claims, including out-of-network and manual tracking requirements
  • Ensure all claims are submitted with correct coding, documentation, and payer-specific requirements
  • Resolve billing discrepancies by identifying root causes, correcting errors, and rebilling claims as needed
  • Ensure compliance with billing and coding regulations and maintain clean documentation for audit readiness

Accounts Receivable & Payment Management

  • Monitor and reconcile the accounts receivable ledger and maintain accurate, up-to-date A/R records
  • Follow up on outstanding balances, unpaid claims, and overdue accounts to support healthy cash flow
  • Post insurance and patient payments to accounts accurately and ensure proper allocation
  • Post zero-balance EOBs and process patient refunds as required
  • Generate and distribute monthly statements to patients and clients
  • Support collections workflows and escalate unresolved balances as appropriate
  • Generate billing and A/R reports for practice leadership on a regular basis

Denials Management & Appeals

  • Review denied claims promptly, research denial reasons, and determine the appropriate course of action
  • Prepare and submit appeals with supporting documentation to secure proper reimbursement
  • Track denial trends and communicate findings to leadership to support process improvements
  • Follow up on appealed claims and rework as needed until resolution
  • Identify and help prevent future denials through accurate claim preparation and payer knowledge

Patient Billing Communication

  • Make outbound calls to patients or guarantors to follow up on outstanding balances, declined payments, or billing questions
  • Communicate billing details, payment options, and insurance responsibilities clearly and professionally
  • Respond to patient inquiries related to statements, claims, and account balances via phone and email
  • Document all billing-related communications and update patient records accordingly

Administrative & Reporting Support

  • Maintain accurate electronic patient records and billing documentation within the EMR
  • Track referrals, plans of care, and authorization-related billing requirements as needed
  • Generate key performance and billing reports for management review
  • Support insurance verification and benefits checks as needed to ensure billing accuracy
  • Assist with administrative workflows, front desk backup duties, or special projects as assigned by the client
  • Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times

Requirements

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on medical billing experience: this is not an entry-level role
  • Proven experience managing the full revenue cycle: claim submission, payment posting, A/R follow-up, and denials
  • Strong working knowledge of insurance billing processes, payer requirements, and reimbursement rules
  • Experience with denials management, including researching, correcting, appealing, and tracking claims to resolution
  • Solid understanding of EOB interpretation, payment reconciliation, and accounts receivable principles
  • Ability to handle both primary and secondary insurance claims, including manual follow-up processes
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills: clear phone communication with patients and payers is essential
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through across all billing activities
  • Ability to work independently, self-direct daily tasks, and meet targets without close supervision
  • Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant remote work

Preferred

  • Experience in an outpatient healthcare setting: physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or similar specialties
  • Familiarity with common healthcare EMR and billing platforms (e.g., Prompt, WebPT, Raintree, or similar)
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, workers' compensation, and out-of-network billing
  • Background working with multi-provider or high-volume clinic environments
  • Comfort with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office (Word/Excel), and cloud-based communication tools

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Ownership: you treat the practice's A/R like your own and don't let claims sit unresolved
  • Expertise: you can read an EOB, identify why a claim was denied, and know exactly what to do next
  • Initiative: when something is off, you flag it, fix it, and help prevent it from happening again
  • Reliability: your client team counts on your daily output; you show up, you deliver, and you communicate clearly
  • Professionalism: you handle patient billing calls with patience, empathy, and accuracy

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth
  • Work within a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive team environment
  • Stable, full-time remote employment with U.S.-based healthcare clients
  • Make a meaningful impact by helping practices serve their patients and communities

Compensation:

Clinical Science Liaison (REMOTE: USA)

JOB OVERVIEW:

The primary role of the Clinical Science Liaison (CSL) is to provide real-time clinical support and interpretation of results to Ambry’s clients. CSLs remain up to date regarding Ambry’s clinical offerings and technology and be subject matter experts for clients calling in to discuss testing results, ordering options, or technology across all of Ambry’s product offerings. CSLs also work collaboratively with Medical Affairs colleagues and internal departments at Ambry to provide optimal client support.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Provide real-time case-level clinical and technical support to providers calling into Ambry’s main line or reaching out through Ambry Portal and liaise between clients, genomic science liaison (GSL), and laboratory (e.g. Reporting, Lab Directors, Genomic Sciences, and Accessioning).
  • Recognize and appropriately relay client feedback and trends that indicate areas for improvement such as process improvements, training needs, educational ideas, marketing needs, changes to test offerings, or overall improvement to the Ambry brand.
  • Provide backup clinical and technical support to providers, Account Executives (AE), and Account Specialists (AS) when the local GSL is unavailable.
  • Document client interactions in appropriate systems and update the local GSL and/or AE when appropriate.
  • Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of all of Ambry’s clinical offerings, including the differences and similarities between products, as well as the standard processes and policies.
  • Identify the need for and help develop resources for the CSL and GSL teams.
  • Other duties as assigned. This may include assisting with the creation of slide decks to be used in the field and/or providing pre-test education to patients.
EDUCATION AND KNOWLEDGE:
  • Master’s degree or higher in genetic counseling, human genetics, or other healthcare field
    • MS in genetic counseling preferred, board certification a plus
  • Must have a strong understanding of the current state of clinical genetic testing, the advantages and limitations of genetic testing, and a desire to educate community providers about the utility of clinical genetics
  • Must have strong communication and organizational skills, work very well independently, be able to collaborate and communicate with clients and internal team members
TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace
  • Basic knowledge of various lab techniques (i.e.NGS, Sanger sequencing, exome sequencing, etc)
EXPERIENCE:
  • At least 2 years’ experience in a genetic testing laboratory or clinic site strongly preferred

What We Do

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project.   • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)

Additional requirements

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Overview

Position Overview

HealthEdge is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy and delivery of the new HealthRules Payer (HRP) WebUI — the modern web-based interface replacing our legacy desktop client. This is a highly visible, ground-up modernization effort spanning the full breadth of the HRP platform, and the successful candidate will own the roadmap, requirements, and user experience direction that guides configuration analysts, claims administrators, and health plan operations users through this transition.

This role requires someone who can balance deep healthcare claims administration domain knowledge with strong product management fundamentals, and who is comfortable partnering closely with UX and engineering to make sound tradeoffs on usability, performance, and migration sequencing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product roadmap and backlog for the HRP WebUI, prioritizing feature parity, usability improvements, and net-new capabilities relative to the legacy desktop application
  • Define detailed requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria for web-based configuration and claims administration screens in partnership with UX designers and engineering leads
  • Lead discovery with configuration analysts, claims administrators, and health plan operations users to understand legacy desktop workflows and translate them into modern, efficient web experiences
  • Develop and communicate a clear migration strategy and sequencing plan for moving customers from the legacy desktop application to the WebUI with minimal disruption
  • Partner with UX/UI designers on interaction design, navigation patterns, and accessibility standards to ensure the WebUI meets modern usability expectations
  • Collaborate with engineering throughout sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release cycles to ensure timely, high-quality delivery
  • Define and track success metrics for WebUI adoption, performance, and user satisfaction, using data to inform prioritization decisions
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on HRP WebUI capabilities for sales, implementation, and customer success teams, including support for customer and prospect conversations
  • Manage stakeholder communication and expectations across customers, executives, and cross-functional teams regarding WebUI roadmap and release timing
  • Support user acceptance testing, pilot programs, and phased rollouts to validate the WebUI against real-world claims administration workflows

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of roadmap, requirements, and delivery for enterprise software products
  • Direct experience in healthcare claims administration, core administrative processing systems (CAPS), or payer operations
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex, legacy desktop workflows into modern web-based user experiences
  • Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with experience balancing competing stakeholder needs across customers, sales, and engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting roadmap and product decisions to executive and customer audiences
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, health administration, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UI/UX development, design systems, or front-end web technologies, sufficient to engage credibly with designers and engineers on interaction design tradeoffs
  • Hands-on familiarity with HealthRules Payer or a comparable core administrative processing system
  • Experience leading legacy-to-web application migrations or platform modernization initiatives
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum product delivery methodologies

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $132,000 to $141,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 consumer services accounts — home services, education, financial services, hospitality, insurance, or similar lead-gen-driven businesses. You will serve as the primary strategic partner for your clients on a day-to-day basis, owning the narrative around performance, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all marketing efforts ladder up to business objectives. A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact.

As an AAD, you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for Consumer Services clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to lead quality, conversion, and revenue — not just lead volume. Every client in this vertical has a sales team, and that sales team will have opinions about whether marketing is delivering. Your job is to make sure you already know the answer before they ask. You will work closely with client marketing and sales or operations contacts to define what a qualified lead actually looks like — and build that definition back into targeting, creative, and campaign strategy. This role requires comfort discussing CPL, lead-to-close rate, cost per acquisition, funnel conversion, and local market dynamics. You'll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track — leading client calls directly on larger accounts, while the PM leads on smaller ones — and will collaborate with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Lead weekly client calls on larger accounts; support PM-led calls on smaller accounts — own the performance narrative either way

  • Stay close to funnel metrics — CPL, lead-to-opportunity rate, cost per acquisition — and surface concerns before the client's sales team does

  • Coordinate paid search, paid social, SEO, local, and creative teams around a unified account strategy
  • Support geographic expansion and local market strategy; flag when market dynamics require a different approach
  • Support the AD on quarterly strategy, renewal prep, and service expansion conversations
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships; contribute to ≥90% retention across your accounts
  • Work in Iris and nova daily; use performance data to surface issues before clients raise them; maintain Pulse cadence at 100%

Role Requirements:

  • 4–7 years in lead generation or consumer services marketing, with experience managing client relationships day-to-day
  • Understands lead funnel economics: CPL, lead-to-opportunity rate, cost per acquisition, LTV by lead source
  • Has worked with clients who have sales teams — knows what aligning marketing to sales looks like in practice
  • Comfortable with paid search-heavy media mixes and local campaign structures
  • Familiar with local SEO, GMB, and review strategy as performance levers in services categories
  • Has experience framing lead quality vs. lead volume conversations for clients, and knows how to shift focus without damaging the relationship
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can translate funnel data into a clear, credible narrative

  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Description

At Sequoia Connect, we are a Talent-First Technology Ecosystem that redefines how elite professionals interact with the global digital landscape. We move beyond traditional models to act as a catalyst for the top 1% of global talent, connecting human potential with complex industrial execution. By joining our inner circle, you are not simply taking a position; you are aligning with a strategic partner dedicated to updating your "Human OS" and accelerating your growth through world-class, high-impact projects.

We are currently partnering with a global IT powerhouse that represents the connected world through innovative, customer-centric experiences. As a USD 6 billion organization and one of the top 7 IT service providers globally, our client empowers over 1,200 global customers—including several Fortune 500 companies—to "Rise™." With a massive network of 163,000+ professionals across 90 countries, they are at the absolute forefront of digital transformation, leveraging next-generation technologies such as 5G, AI, Blockchain, and Quantum Computing.

This is your chance to thrive in a workplace recognized as one of the most sustainable corporations in the world. You will join an environment that values innovation and societal impact, working on end-to-end digital transformation projects for global leaders. If you are a driven professional looking for global career opportunities and exposure to high-impact projects within an international network of expertise, this is where you belong.

We are currently searching for a Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer:

The Challenge (Responsibilities)

  • Build and calibrate change-detection and anomaly models on multi-temporal Sentinel-1/2 imagery over pipeline corridors.
  • Learn per-site "normal terrain" baselines and validate detections against a ground-truth event log (detection rate, lead time, false-positive rate, AUC).
  • Fine-tune geospatial foundation models (Prithvi-EO or similar) with LoRA/PEFT on limited labelled data.
  • Implement SAR techniques for displacement: amplitude change, coherence, and pixel-offset tracking to measure pipe and dune movement.
  • Develop dune-migration tracking (optical flow / feature tracking), migration direction, and mobility indices.
  • Engineer robust ingestion from Copernicus (CDSE / Sentinel Hub / STAC) and fuse optical, SAR, DEM, and ERA5 wind data.
  • Design labelling strategy (encroachment masks, severity) and a train/validation split that avoids leakage.
  • Communicate results and limitations honestly to technical and business stakeholders.

Your Profile (Requirements)

  • 7+ years of applied data science / ML experience, with hands-on geospatial remote sensing.
  • Strong Python programming skills, including numpy, rasterio/GDAL, xarray, scikit-image, and geopandas/shapely.
  • Working knowledge of optical and SAR data (spectral indices, backscatter/dB, resolution trade-offs, revisit).
  • Deep learning expertise with PyTorch, including experience fine-tuning models (transfer learning, LoRA/PEFT).
  • Proven ability in model validation and calibration: ROC/AUC, thresholding, cross-validation, and handling weak/few labels.
  • Experience with time-series / change-detection methods and coordinate reference systems (UTM, reprojection).
  • High-Performance Mindset: Resilience, emotional intelligence, and a focus on agile delivery.
  • Technologist DNA: A deep understanding of the difference between "coding" and "engineering."

Desired

  • Experience with InSAR / SAR offset tracking (SNAP, ISCE, or equivalent) for surface/structure displacement.
  • Familiarity with geospatial foundation models (Prithvi-EO, TerraTorch, HLS) and segmentation.
  • Knowledge of Copernicus/CDSE, Sentinel Hub, STAC, and Planetary Computer.
  • Exposure to Aeolian geomorphology, dune dynamics, or the oil & gas / pipeline-integrity domain.
  • Experience with MLOps and cloud environments (containerisation, scheduled inference, geospatial data pipelines).
  • MSc/PhD in Remote Sensing, Geospatial Science, Earth Observation, CS/ML, Physics, or equivalent experience.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native foundations or AI coding assistants.

Languages

  • Advanced Oral English: For seamless collaboration with global teams.
  • Advanced Spanish.

Special Notes

  • Preference for candidates with Space Tech experience, though not mandatory.

Work Arrangement

We value flexibility to support your lifestyle. This position is available as:

  • Remote.

If you meet these qualifications and are pursuing new challenges, start your application on our website to join an award-winning employer. Explore all our job openings | Sequoia Career’s Page:

Requirements

7+ years applied data science / ML, with hands-on geospatial remote sensing. Strong Python: numpy, rasterio/GDAL, xarray, scikit-image, geopandas/shapely. Working knowledge of optical and SAR data (spectral indices, backscatter/dB, resolution trade-offs, revisit). Deep learning with PyTorch; experience fine-tuning models (transfer learning, LoRA/PEFT). Model validation and calibration: ROC/AUC, thresholding, cross-validation, handling weak/few labels. Time-series / change-detection methods and coordinate reference systems (UTM, reprojection).

About StartEngine

StartEngine is the FinTech powerhouse driving the future of fundraising and alternative investing. StartEngine was founded by Howard Marks, the co-founder of Activision (now valued at over $75B), with the goal of helping entrepreneurs achieve their dreams by removing funding barriers. Howard partnered with co-founder Ron Miller, a veteran entrepreneur and early advocate of equity crowdfunding, to build a platform that democratizes access to capital. In 2020, StartEngine welcomed Shark Tank judge and serial entrepreneur Kevin O’Leary (aka Mr. Wonderful) as Strategic Advisor and Investor. Since its inception, StartEngine has helped over 550 companies raise more than $ from retail investors, with investments starting at as little as $100.
Why merely back a company when you can own a piece of it?
As a Startup Sourcing Associate, you’ll be responsible for discovering and engaging early-stage and growth-stage companies that could raise capital on StartEngine.
This is a top-of-funnel, lead-generation role — you’ll be researching the startup landscape, finding promising companies, and sparking conversations with founders to gauge their interest in raising on our platform. Once a company is interested, you’ll introduce them to our Account Executive team to take it from there.
This position is perfect for someone who loves the startup ecosystem, enjoys networking with founders, and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Do

  • Identify high-potential startups through online research, funding databases, news outlets, pitch competitions, and accelerator networks
  • Engage founders and leadership teams via LinkedIn, email, and other creative channels to introduce StartEngine
  • Qualify opportunities and schedule intro meetings for our Senior Sales (AE) team
  • Build relationships with accelerators, incubators, and venture programs to create ongoing deal flow
  • Monitor trends in venture capital and private markets to stay ahead of emerging opportunities
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach and pipeline activity in our CRM

Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in business development, venture scouting, or startup outreach
  • FINRA series 7,63 required
  • Deep interest in the startup world, venture capital, or early-stage investing (absolutely required)
  • Excellent written communication and persistence — you know how to get founders’ attention
  • Resourceful and creative in sourcing leads — you love finding new ways to identify potential partners
  • Organized and proactive, comfortable working independently and meeting ambitious goals
  • Familiarity with platforms like Crunchbase, PitchBook, AngelList, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus

Perks & Benefits

  • 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision - pick your own plan
  • Generous Equity package
  • Unlimited PTO and sick days
  • Paid WeWork Usage (optional)
  • 100% Remote
  • Team Off-sites and Celebration Dinners
  • Paid Maternity/Paternity leave
  • 401K program
  • Flexible hours
  • Be part of one of the fastest growing parts of the FinTech Industry
  • A chance to work with a highly profitable and rapidly expanding startup (not VC funded)

raw.description:
Position Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce DevOps Engineer to support development, testing, and deployment by automating CI/CD pipelines, workflows, managing version control (e.g., Git), and maintaining data integrity within Salesforce environments. You will manage the pipeline security and support the end-to-end releases for multiple Salesforce orgs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including development, QA, and business stakeholders, to support and execute the releases, weekly, 3-week, and project-based releases. You will also be responsible for back-promoting changes across lower-level orgs to ensure that all environments remain in sync.
As the Salesforce DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for bridging development and IT operations to enable faster, safer releases using tools like Copado or Gearset, while managing metadata, enforcing best practices, and ensuring environment synchronization. You will be mentoring project team members when needed and ultimately ensuring that our multiple Salesforce orgs stay in sync and healthy.

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • CI/CD Pipeline: Own and optimize the CI/CD pipeline for Salesforce development, leveraging tools such as Copado to enable efficient, automated, and reliable deployment processes.
  • Copado Pipeline Management: Design, configure, and maintain deployment pipelines to promote metadata and code across Salesforce environments, maximizing automation and ensuring consistency throughout the release lifecycle.
  • This is a Remote (work from home) position.
  • Version Control & Source Control: Manage branching strategies, commit code changes, and oversee merge processes using platforms such as GitHub, ensuring code integrity, traceability, and effective team collaboration.
  • Environment Management: Maintain synchronization across development, testing (sandbox), and production environments, including data seeding activities. Support sandbox refresh processes and collaborate with Release Engineers to ensure environment readiness and stability.
  • Security: Design and implement pipeline workflows that enforce controlled access and proper segregation of duties. Conduct monthly release audits to identify and validate any unauthorized changes outside of managed pipelines.
  • Release Process Optimization: Continuously automate and enhance release processes to improve deployment efficiency, reduce conflicts, and increase overall reliability.
  • Release Management: Own end-to-end Salesforce release planning, coordination, and execution across multiple environments for the assigned projects. Communicate release activities with stakeholders, including developers, QA teams, operations, and business owners, ensuring alignment and transparency.
  • Deployment Execution: Manage deployments of Apex code, Lightning components, and configuration changes across environments. Handle merge conflicts and troubleshoot deployment failures to ensure smooth releases.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify potential risks, perform pre-deployment validations, and develop robust rollback strategies to minimize impact on production environments
  • Back-Promotion: Ensure all changes are accurately back-promoted to lower-level Salesforce orgs to maintain consistency, integrity, and alignment across environments.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with developers, administrators, and QA teams to coordinate releases, resolve blockers, and support testing cycles.
  • Monitoring & Governance: Monitoring deployment success, troubleshooting errors, maintaining audit trails, and ensuring compliance.
  • Data and Backup Management: Implement and manage robust data backup solutions and oversee data migration activities to safeguard critical business information.
Skills:
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including sandboxes, production environments, and metadata management.
  • Hands-on experience with release automation and integration tools (e.g., Copado, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, SFDX).
  • Proficiency in using version control systems (Git) and automation tools to ensure a streamlined, repeatable deployment process.
  • Familiarity with Agile and DevOps methodologies, and experience in managing releases in a fastpaced, iterative development environment.
  • Detail-oriented and organized with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
  • Ability to create and enforce robust DevOps policies, including version control, rollback strategies, and deployment schedules.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across different teams (technical, business, and executive).
Education & Experience:
Education:
  • Bachelor’s Degree


Experience:
  • 5+ years of experience as a Salesforce DevOps Engineer or Developer. Previous UMGC experience is a plus.
  • Proven expertise in CI/CD pipeline management, experience with tools like Change set, Copado, AutoRABIT, Gearset, Ant Deployment, Azure Devops, and Jenkins
  • In-depth experience with Salesforce deployments, including change sets, ant migration, and Salesforce DX
  • Experience in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies
  • Experience in Agile methodology, working in 3-week sprints, daily scrums, etc.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce best practices and functionality
  • Knowledge of Source-format approaches preferred
Required Certifications:
  • Salesforce Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator.
  • Copado Certifications: Copado Fundamentals I and II Certifications
Preferred Certifications:
  • Salesforce Certifications: Salesforce Certified Developer, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer
  • Copado Certifications: Copado Extension Builder, Copado AI Certification
  • UMGC or USM prior experience preferred.

raw.title: Remote High-Ticket Closer
raw.excerpt: This position offers $100K guaranteed minimum with uncapped commissions selling a $6,400 business consulting offer to leads who were generated primarily through Meta adsPlease do not apply unless you can provide real numbers from your previous sales roles.
raw.description:
This position offers $100K guaranteed minimum with uncapped commissions selling a $6,400 business consulting offer to leads who were generated primarily through Meta ads

Please do not apply unless you can provide real numbers from your previous sales roles.

During the interview process, be prepared to walk us through how many calls you took, how many sales you made, what the offer cost, where the leads came from, how much revenue you personally closed, and exactly how your close rate was calculated.

-----

Dear future sales rep,

We’re searching for someone who is incredible at turning skeptical strangers into clients by truly understanding what is happening in their business, helping them see what needs to change, and guiding them through the fears and objections keeping them stuck.

Most of our prospects first discover us through Meta ads. By the time they reach your calendar, they have applied to speak with us and have some familiarity with our company, but most are still cold or lukewarm.

You will need to earn their trust.

You will need to diagnose the real problem.

You will need to help qualified prospects make a clear decision instead of letting them run back to the same habits that have kept their business stuck for years.

This role is a top priority at 6 Figure Creative because our entire company exists to help creative freelancers solve one giant problem:

They have no idea where their next client is coming from.

Everything we do is designed to help them solve that problem permanently by building a repeatable client acquisition system.

We're an established, profitable company doing roughly $2.5 million in annual revenue, with a consistent paid acquisition engine generating sales opportunities primarily through Meta ads.

We know there is significantly more upside available with the right person in this seat, so we’re looking for a proven closer who can help us raise the bar for the entire sales team.

Why we are offering a $100K guaranteed minimum

Most remote sales jobs throw out a giant OTE number, give you no guarantee whatsoever, and make you absorb all the risk of joining a company you have never worked with before.

We are doing something different.

We want someone with a real, documented track record who already has other options.

We also understand that joining a smaller sales team is a risk. You do not know yet how good our leads are, how strong the offer is, how the company operates, or whether the opportunity is as good as we say it is.

So we are taking most of that downside off your plate.

You will receive a guaranteed minimum of $100,000 per year while keeping the full upside of our existing uncapped commission structure.

To be completely clear, this is not a $100,000 salary plus commissions.

Each month, you receive whichever amount is greater:

  • $8,333.33 in guaranteed compensation
  • The commissions you earned that month

There is no negative draw balance.

You never owe the guarantee back.

If your commissions exceed the guarantee, you receive the higher commission amount.

The guarantee does not mean the performance standard is lower. It means we are willing to take a real financial risk to attract someone capable of raising it.

If you are looking for a comfortable $100,000 job where you can close 15% of your calls and hide, this is not that job.

If you perform at the level your track record suggests, the guaranteed minimum should eventually stop mattering because your commissions will be higher.

What You'll Do

As our Remote High-Ticket Closer, your primary responsibility is converting qualified prospects into clients for our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint.

You will conduct consultative enrollment calls over Zoom, diagnose the prospect’s business challenges, determine whether they are a strong fit, clearly explain how we can help, and confidently ask qualified prospects to enroll.

These are not random cold calls.

The prospects have applied to speak with us, but most were originally generated through paid Meta ads and will not arrive fully sold.

Once a prospect lands on your calendar, you own that opportunity from preparation through follow-up and final decision.

Your main responsibilities include:

1: Enrollment calls:

You will spend most of your time helping prospects determine whether our consulting sprint is right for them.

If they truly need our help and are a strong fit, you should see it as your responsibility to help them make the decision instead of allowing fear, uncertainty, or a weak objection to send them back to the same situation they wanted to escape.

That means you will:

  • Review every application before the call
  • Diagnose the real issues inside the prospect’s business
  • Understand their goals, urgency, financial situation, and readiness
  • Determine whether they are a strong fit for our consulting sprint
  • Clearly explain our process, expectations, and investment
  • Make a direct recommendation when you believe they should enroll
  • Handle objections with empathy, patience, and confidence
  • Disqualify prospects who are not a good fit
  • Avoid enrolling obvious red-flag or high-risk clients just to hit a sales number

2: CRM and lead ownership

You will take complete ownership of every lead assigned to you inside GoHighLevel.

No qualified opportunity should be lost because of weak follow-up, incomplete notes, or an unclear next step.

That means you will:

  • Keep every opportunity stage accurate
  • Complete detailed notes after every call
  • Record the outcome and next step for every prospect
  • Complete all required follow-up on time
  • Reschedule qualified prospects who miss their calls
  • Work no-shows through our recovery process
  • Continue following up until the prospect enrolls, declines, or is formally closed out
  • Keep your sales data accurate enough that we never have to guess what is happening inside your pipeline

3: Call review and improvement

Every enrollment call is recorded.

You should already be excellent at sales when you join us. Call review here is about sharpening strong performance, identifying patterns, testing better approaches, and turning individual wins into improvements the entire sales team can use.

You will regularly review your own calls, participate in team call reviews and roleplay, and bring useful insights from your conversations back to the rest of the company.

That means you will:

  • Review your own calls and identify specific areas to improve
  • Bring useful wins, losses, and difficult calls to team call reviews
  • Give and receive direct, thoughtful feedback
  • Test new approaches instead of relying on the same script forever
  • Apply what we learn to future calls
  • Help identify patterns in objections, lead quality, messaging, and offer positioning
  • Share what is working so the entire sales team improves alongside you

4: Improve the company’s sales process

You will work closely with me, the founder, to continuously improve our offer, messaging, scripts, follow-up, and overall sales process.

You are talking directly to the market every day. That makes your feedback extremely valuable.

You will help us:

  • Identify recurring objections and concerns
  • Find weaknesses in our messaging or offer
  • Improve our enrollment call structure
  • Improve email and text follow-up
  • Reduce the time between the first call and the final decision
  • Share useful insights with our marketing and consulting teams
  • Build a stronger sales system for everyone who joins after you

What Success In This Role Looks Like

We are hiring someone who can raise the bar, not just hit the current one.

Within six months, the expectation is that you are handling approximately 70 to 80 completed sales calls per month and maintaining a 30% or greater close rate.

A 35% or greater close rate would be exceptional.

We expect a fast ramp:

  • 9 or more new clients in your first full production month
  • 12 or more in your second full production month
  • 15 or more in your third full production month

Your first-year target is at least 225 new clients, with 250 or more as the goal.

Who you'll work with

You will report directly to me (Brian Hood), the founder and person writing this job description.

You will also work alongside a veteran closer who has been with the company for 3+ years.

We are not a 40-person boiler room where you are handed a script, dropped into a Slack channel, and treated like rep number 37.

Why apply for this job?

If you’re an experienced sales rep who wants to use your skills to help transform the lives of creatives who run freelance businesses, this job might be the perfect fit for you.

Our clients include Grammy-winning music producers, designers, videographers, and other creative freelancers.

Despite being extremely talented at their craft, they have never been taught how to consistently find and close clients.

The decision you help them make on a sales call can completely change their career.

Not only will you be affecting the lives and businesses of the people you enroll in our consulting program, but you’ll also be impacting each and every client they work with as well.

If you’re a high performer who’s been stuck in a toxic sales team and you want to help create a healthy, thriving sales culture, you’ll love being able to help us build out the sales team from the ground up and set the right culture from day one.

If you’ve spent years selling products you don’t believe in, this is an opportunity to use your talent on something that genuinely helps people build better businesses and lives.

If you are tired of being one of dozens of closers with no influence over anything upstream, you will have direct access to the founder and a real voice in how we improve the company.

If you want the upside of commission without gambling your income while learning a completely new company, offer, and lead source, that is exactly why we created the guaranteed minimum.

Where you'll work

Our entire company operates remotely, with a diverse team spread across the United States, Portugal, England, Romania, Israel, and South Korea.

You can work from home, a quiet coworking space, or anywhere else with reliable internet and a professional place to take calls.

You must be available to take calls during U.S. business hours and have a setup where prospects will not hear dogs barking, roommates yelling, or a coffee grinder running during their enrollment call.

What We Do At 6 Figure Creative (And Why We Do It)

6 Figure Creative is a business consultancy for creative freelancers who are stuck relying on referrals, word of mouth, inconsistent content, or last-minute desperate outreach to find clients.

Our mission is to help creatives earn more without selling their souls.

Our 90-Day Client Acquisition Consulting Sprint helps freelancers build and implement a repeatable system for attracting and closing clients.

We believe that the education system is fundamentally broken. Universities will gladly charge their students $100k+ for a creative degree and never teach them the most important skills and strategies for how to actually get an ROI from their investment.

The consulting program you’ll be selling exists to help the best creatives in the world change the trajectory of their careers (and lives) by learning the skills universities failed to teach them.

It takes more than passion to succeed, and everything we do is built around giving our clients the strategies, tools, processes, guidance, consulting, and accountability they need to have successful businesses.

If this sounds like the opportunity you’ve been looking for, apply below.

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Oak Street Health®, a part of CVS Health, helps older adults stay healthier and live fuller lives through our 230 centers across 27 states. Our value-based care model helps us consistently deliver better patient experiences and outcomes, by providing holistic, comprehensive and integrated care right in our patients' communities, we can help keep our patients healthy and reinvest cost savings in further care for those same communities and others.

raw.description:
Contexte 

A l’ère de l’industrie 4.0, l’intégration de l’Intelligence Artificielle (IA) dans les Systèmes d’Information Industriels transforme les process de production.

L’IA, couplée à l’Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) et à la quantité grandissante de données qu’il est possible de générer et de capter, permet d’optimiser les performances, de prédire des pannes, d’améliorer la prise de décision, etc. Ces systèmes complexes sont constitués d’un réseau de capteurs, d’actionneurs, d’automates et de plateformes d’analyse de données, souvent connectés à Internet, exposant ainsi ces environnements industriels à de nouveaux risques.

Cependant, l’introduction de l’IA et l’utilisation accrue des données dans ces systèmes soulèvent des questions majeures de cybersécurité. L'IA peut être exploitée à des fins malveillantes, que ce soit par la manipulation de données, l’attaque des algorithmes d’apprentissage ou l'exploitation de failles de sécurité des systèmes existants. La sécurisation des SI industriels devient un enjeu crucial dans un contexte où la cohabitation de systèmes anciens et modernes, utilisant des protocoles variés et parfois vulnérables, crée un terrain propice à des cyberattaques sophistiquées.

L’IA n’est que l’un des aspects d’un plus grand concept, l’industrie 4.0. Derrière ce mot-chapeau, on regroupe les innovations technologiques permettant à l’industrie de gagner en efficacité. L’organisation des unités de production est repensée, aussi bien leur conception interne que les échanges avec les autres systèmes de l’entreprise. On parle également de smart factories (usines intelligentes).

Comment aujourd’hui assurer la sécurité d’appareils au sein d’un parc hétérogène où cohabitent systèmes récents et obsolètes. Si une telle situation était permise tant que l’ensemble de ces appareils fonctionnaient en vase clos, elle n’est plus tolérable lorsque le système est connecté à Internet.

Objectif du stage 

L’objectif du stage/alternance est de compléter la vision de la sécurité de l'usine du future (exigences métier, enjeux de sécurité, analyse de risques, niveau de maturité, architecture cible, etc.), d’appréhender le sujet de l’IA et de construire les outils et méthodes permettant d’évaluer le niveau de maturité et les recommandations portant sur la sécurisation des environnements industriels.

Travaux à réaliser 

Sous la tutelle d’un.e consultant.e et le pilotage d’un.e manager, le/la stagiaire pourra être amené.e à réaliser une partie ou la totalité des travaux suivants : 

  • Analyse des risques majeurs portant sur le SI Industriel et particulièrement sur l’IA.
  • Conception d’un outil de bilan de maturité (Excel, questionnaire…) sur le sujet du SI Industriel et particulièrement sur l’IA.
  • Réalisation d’un « Proof of Concept » (test consistant à faire une première version simple pour voir si l’idée est réalisable ou non)basé sur l’évaluation du niveau de sécurité d'un ou plusieurs systèmes industriels ou d’IA.

L’intitulé et le cadrage exact du sujet de stage ou du travail à effectuer seront confirmés en début de stage. 

Diplômé(e) ou futur(e) diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou d’une université, vous disposez d’une formation solide et/ou d’un intérêt marqué pour les enjeux technologiques et de cybersécurité.

Nous recherchons avant tout des profils curieux, structurés et dotés d’une forte capacité d’analyse, capables d’intervenir sur des problématiques complexes et d’échanger aussi bien avec des interlocuteurs métiers que techniques.

Tous nos stages de fin d'études s'inscrivent dans une logique de pré-embauche.

Wavestone est un employeur inclusif qui s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Dans le cadre de cette politique de diversité et inclusion, Wavestone accompagne les personnes en situation de handicap et/ou nécessitant un aménagement durant leur process de recrutement et lors de leur prise de poste.

Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.

Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.

Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.
