Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (Design System) who thinks at a system level and understands how to create a scalable UI ecosystem that spans multiple products, teams, and platforms. You are not just designing static screens; you are building the foundation of our product user interfaces.
In this role, you will take full ownership of our component libraries, interaction models, and cross-platform design consistency. You will act as the bridge between design and engineering, ensuring that our visual assets translate seamlessly into clean, reusable, and accessible production code.

Responsibilities

  • UI Craft & Visual Excellence: Maintain an exceptionally high standard for layout, typography, colour, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall digital finish across all reusable elements.
  • Component Architecture: Design, build, and maintain robust component libraries (buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, forms, tables, etc.) that scale seamlessly across products.
  • Interaction & Motion Design: Define interactive behaviors and state transitions (e.g., hover, focus, disabled, loading, and mobile behaviors) to ensure components feel alive and intuitive.
  • Design Token Management: Structure and maintain design tokens (colours, spacing, typography, border-radius, shadows) to drive consistency between design environments and code.
  • Figma Library Architecture: Organize complex variants, properties, and components within Figma to empower other product designers to build quickly and accurately.
  • Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering teams to navigate technical constraints across Web, React, Flutter, Android, and iOS/Native app environments.
  • Documentation & Governance: Create clear, comprehensive usage guidelines and documentation outlining when, why, and how components should (and should not) be used.

Experience & Background

  • Proven Design System Track Record: Extensive experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-ready design systems rather than just standalone product features.
  • Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android.
  • Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows.
  • Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories.

Skills & Competencies

  • Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication.
  • Accessibility Champion: Solid grasp of accessibility standards (WCAG), contrast requirements, and inclusive design principles.
  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology.
  • Communication & Documentation: Excellent writing and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex design system choices into clear executive-level updates and technical guidelines.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • High Adoption & Efficiency: Design and engineering teams actively use the system, resulting in significantly accelerated product shipping cycles.
  • Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS).
  • Best-in-Class Documentation: A central, living source of truth that leaves no ambiguity regarding design tokens, component rules, or brand compliance.
  • Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
  • Fully remote work culture and support for professional development.

How to apply:

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

raw.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España:
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom:
We are looking for a skilled iOS engineer who is ready to learn and keen to join our expert team developing new features and extending the existing ones in our main product!
We welcome talented, passionate, innovative, result-oriented professionals who strive to absorb new knowledge and technologies and are willing to use them.

In this role, you will work within a modern development environment that leverages a modular architecture with Swift Package Manager (SPM), hybrid UI workflows combining SwiftUI for views and UIKit for navigation, and Swift Concurrency. You will be part of a team committed to high code quality through high unit test coverage (80%+) and cutting-edge agentic End-to-End (E2E) workflows.

Your main responsibilities are:

  • Build Core Software: Design and develop enterprise-quality software components based on product specifications, delivering brand-new features as well as enhancements to existing ones.
  • Ensure Code Quality & Reliability: Write clean code adhering to team guidelines, implement robust tests, and troubleshoot technical or application issues as they arise.
  • Collaborate Across the Lifecycle: Work daily alongside fellow developers throughout the full software development lifecycle, and prepare clear technical documentation to enrich our iOS knowledge base.
  • Drive Continuous Innovation: Stay current with industry best practices and proactively bring fresh, creative ideas to the engineering team.

Does this sound like you:

  • Proven iOS Engineering Background: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering (or a similar field) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience developing Swift-based iOS applications within agile teams—including a track record of publishing and continuously supporting one or more live apps.
  • Core Technical & Architectural Mastery: You are confident in software architecture and design, with deep proficiency in MVVM (or similar modern patterns), OOP principles, iOS Frameworks, and Git/Gitflow workflows.
  • Modern UI & Domain Experience: You bring strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, processes, and memory management, combined with practical experience building pixel-perfect UIs with SwiftUI and Auto-Layout, alongside domain exposure to payment systems and marketplaces.
  • Quality & Modern Workflow Expertise: You prioritize software reliability through Unit Testing, Feature Testing, and Mocking, and you bring solid, up-to-date knowledge of AI workflows and agentic engineering.
  • Strong Collaboration & English Skills: You possess strong communication skills and full fluency in English, thriving in a team-first development environment.

Bonus:

  • UI/UX & Testing: Knowledge of UI/UX best practices and experience in A/B testing.
  • Agile & Telecom: Prior experience with SCRUM and other agile methods.
  • Domain Knowledge: Prior work experience in telecommunications, including knowledge of eSIM and GSMA related technologies and services.

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. About CSP Control Center (C3)
CSP Control Center (C3) is a leading Microsoft CSP Billing Automation and Subscription Management platform that enables Microsoft Direct Bill Partners, Indirect Providers, and Distributors to automate and scale their cloud business.
As C3 continues its global expansion, we are looking for an experienced, target-driven Head of Sales/ Sales Head to lead new customer acquisition, build a high-performing sales organization, and drive predictable revenue growth.
Role Summary
The Head of Sales is responsible for driving net-new business revenue for C3 globally. This is a leadership role for an individual who thrives in a high-growth SaaS environment, has a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, and can build, lead, and scale a high-performing sales team.
The ideal candidate is a strong sales leader with experience selling enterprise software solutions, managing quota-carrying sales teams, and developing repeatable sales processes that consistently deliver results.
Key Responsibilities
Revenue Ownership
  • Own and achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual new business revenue targets.
  • Develop and execute the global sales strategy to accelerate customer acquisition.
  • Drive ARR and MRR growth through consistent new logo acquisition.
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline with predictable revenue outcomes.
  • Personally engage in strategic sales opportunities to support the team in closing high-value deals.
Sales Leadership
  • Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing sales team.
  • Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and high performance.
  • Set individual quotas, monitor performance, and coach team members to exceed targets consistently.
  • Conduct regular pipeline reviews, deal inspections, and performance reviews.
  • Identify skill gaps and implement coaching and development plans.
    .
Sales Execution
  • Establish and standardize the sales process from lead qualification through deal closure.
  • Improve sales productivity and win rates through structured sales methodologies.
  • Ensure accurate pipeline management and sales forecasting.
  • Drive CRM discipline and sales reporting across the team.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with Marketing, Partner Success, Product Management, and Leadership to:
  • Improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Align go-to-market strategies.
  • Share customer and market feedback.
  • Drive continuous improvements across the revenue organization.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Revenue
  • New Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
  • Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
  • New Customer Acquisition
  • Quota Achievement
  • Average Deal Size
  • Sales Performance
  • Pipeline Coverage
  • Win Rate
  • Sales Cycle Length
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • Pipeline Conversion Rate
  • Team Performance
  • Team Revenue Achievement
  • Individual Quota Attainment
  • Sales Productivity
  • Coaching Effectiveness
  • Employee Retention

Requirements

  • 10–15 years of B2B software or SaaS sales experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading quota-carrying sales teams.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience building and scaling sales teams in a high-growth environment.
  • Strong experience in enterprise solution selling and complex commercial negotiations.
  • Experience managing sales forecasts, pipelines, and performance metrics.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
Desired Skills
  • Enterprise SaaS Sales
  • New Business Development
  • Sales Leadership
  • Team Building & Coaching
  • Strategic Negotiation
  • Sales Forecasting
  • Pipeline Management
  • CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce)
  • Presentation & Communication
  • Value-Based Selling
Leadership Competencies
  • The successful candidate should demonstrate:
  • Strong hunter mentality with a passion for winning new business.
  • Results-oriented and highly target-driven.
  • Ability to build, motivate, and scale high-performing sales teams.
  • Excellent coaching and mentoring capabilities.
  • Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
  • Data-driven decision-making.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence.
Success in the First 12 Months
The successful candidate will:
  • Build a predictable and measurable sales engine.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed new business revenue targets.
  • Hire and develop a high-performing sales team.
  • Improve sales conversion rates and forecast accuracy.
  • Establish scalable sales processes and best practices.
  • Strengthen collaboration between Marketing, Sales, and Partner Success.
Why Join C3?
This is an opportunity to lead the sales function of a rapidly growing global SaaS product focused on the Microsoft CSP ecosystem. You'll have the autonomy to shape the sales organization, build a winning team, and play a pivotal role in driving the next phase of C3's growth.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a builder and leader—someone who has successfully led teams of quota-carrying sales professionals, consistently delivered against ambitious revenue targets, and knows how to create a culture of performance and accountability. This role requires a hands-on leader who enjoys coaching, closing strategic opportunities, and scaling a world-class sales organization.
